raw.description:
About us:

Branch is on a mission to empower workers with financial freedom. We do this by helping companies accelerate payments and providing working Americans with accessible, free financial services. We’re committed to building and delivering more inclusive, transparent, and frictionless financial products.

Our goal of empowerment extends to our own employees, too. Have a great idea? Share it today and it might just get implemented tomorrow. As a member of our team, your voice and creativity matter—and they can directly impact our products, company, and culture.

We not only focus on attracting great talent from across the country, but also on building teams that help that talent thrive. That means valuing a diversity of opinions and working styles, while creating a shared belief in innovation, initiative, and winning together.

Come join our team as we develop new ways to improve the lives of working Americans.

About the role:

Branch helps millions of workers get paid faster and manage their money better. Our team is responsible for the data that drives many critical processes at Branch, including money movement, automated fraud response, and client reporting.

We're looking for a Data Engineer to join our Data Engineering team. In this role, you’ll work with other engineers and stakeholders to build and maintain the pipelines that power the rest of Branch. You'll deliver new pipelines and build the underlying components (hooks, utilities, internal libraries) that future pipelines will be built from.

This is a great role for someone with a few years of data engineering experience who's ready to grow into more end-to-end ownership. Our team is small, high-trust, and values clarity, maintainability, and getting the details right.

What You'll Do:

  • Build and maintain data pipelines that other teams and customers rely on
  • Integrate with internal and external APIs to send and receive data
  • Orchestrate and automate workflows using Airflow on Kubernetes
  • Implement unit tests, monitoring, and alerting to ensure data reliability
  • Improve the observability and efficiency of existing pipelines
  • Monitor production pipelines, debug issues, and document root causes
  • Work with stakeholders to clarify requirements and validate assumptions
  • Contribute to design discussions and surface functional gaps early

What We're Looking For:

Required

  • 3+ years of Data Engineering experience
  • 3+ years of Airflow experience
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Working knowledge of our existing tech stack: Snowflake, Airflow, DBT, GCP
  • BS in Computer Science or related field

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or a related industry
  • Experience with managing Airflow

Compensation:

The base salary range for this role is $135-145k. The salary range displayed reflects an average base salary range for the position across all the U.S. The base salary offered to an applicant could be higher or lower based on each applicant's specific skill set, depth of experience, relevant education or training, etc.

Location:

This position is classified as REMOTEwithin the United States of America.

We are unable to hire candidates located outside of the domestic U.S.

Benefits:

  • Market-leading medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Stock options
  • Free Premium-Tier Origin Financial Wellness subscription
  • Monthly home-office stipend
  • 401k (TransAmerica)
  • 12-weeks paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents
  • Flexible time off + sick and safe time
  • 11 paid company holidays
  • Branch@Branch Same Day Pay Option

Identity VerificationAs part of our application process, you'll receive a separate email from Greenhouse shortly containing a unique identity verification link. This step, powered by Persona, helps us confirm applicant identities and keep our hiring process secure for everyone.

Upon identity verification, all biometric data is deleted. If you need support completing this application, please reach out to

Working at Branch

A remote-first company with employees located throughout the U.S., Branch emphasizes transparency, accountability, and trust to create a collaborative environment where our product, engineering, marketing, customer support, customer success, and sales teams can all thrive together. Learn more about what we do in this video!

Our collaborative spirit has helped us become an award-winning FinTech company, with Branch’s innovation and workplace recognized across industries. Branch has been honored by Inc., the Webby Awards, Benzinga FinTech Awards, FinTech Breakthrough Awards, Top Workplaces USA, Great Places to Work, and EY Entrepreneur of the Year, Heartland, among others.

Learn more about our culture, approach, technology, and people here:

Branch is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Must be currently authorized to work in the USA without sponsorship or transfer.

No third-parties, please.

raw.description:
SimpleTiger is hiring a part-time contract web developer to build, improve, and troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot, with the potential to grow into a larger role.

We’re a B2B SaaS marketing agency helping software companies grow through SEO, content marketing, paid media, and answer engine optimization (AEO). Our clients’ websites are where much of that work comes to life, and we’re looking for a developer who can turn ideas into clean, functional pages quickly.

As part of our delivery team, you’ll work primarily on client websites, translating designs, campaign concepts, and SEO recommendations into effective web experiences. From building new pages to fixing issues on existing sites, you’ll help turn our marketing strategy into work that’s ready to launch.

Key responsibilities

  • Build, update, or troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot CMS

  • Make technical fixes and improvements to live client sites, with clear details on what was tested, implemented, and performance comparisons using tools like Screaming Frog, pagespeed insights, and Lighthouse

  • Build and connect forms, lead routing, and simple automations between a site and the client’s marketing tools

  • Set up and check tracking, like GA4, Google Tag Manager, and HubSpot tracking in Tandem with the SEO Manager

  • Keep sites fast, accessible, and friendly to SEO (page speed, Core Web Vitals, clean markup, image optimizations, cache lifetime improvements, and so on)

  • Write clear and timely notes on what you are actively working on, and any updates pushed live so our team and the client can follow along

Qualifications and skills

  • You’re a hands-on developer who can build from scratch, troubleshoot existing sites, and make improvements without disrupting what’s already working.

Required skills

  • WordPress development: Strong experience with custom themes, child themes, blocks, page builders, and Advanced Custom Fields (ACF). You can build a page from the ground up—not just edit an existing one.

  • HubSpot CMS development: Strong experience with HubL templates, modules, and themes, including building and troubleshooting pages, forms, and email templates.

  • Front-end development: Solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript skills, with the ability to navigate existing code and understand how changes affect the live site.

  • APIs and integrations: Experience working with the HubSpot or WordPress REST APIs, plus CRMs and marketing tools such as Salesforce, Zapier, n8n, Airtable, and Slack.

  • Technical audits and fixes: Experience using Screaming Frog to audit WordPress and HubSpot sites, interpret findings, and resolve technical issues.

  • Code review and cleanup: Comfort working within WordPress and HubSpot codebases to identify legacy or unused JavaScript and CSS, determine what’s still needed, and safely remove what isn’t.

  • Async communication: Clear, timely written communication, especially through Slack.

  • Independent work: Strong time management and the ability to meet deadlines, flag blockers early, and keep projects moving without close supervision.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Webflow development and auditing experience, including building a clean CMS structure.

  • PHP development experience.

  • Previous work at a marketing agency or with B2B SaaS clients.

  • Familiarity with SEO and conversion best practices.

  • Experience with Git and version control.

What success looks like

Success means delivering clean, reliable development work that helps our team turn marketing plans into live client experiences.

  • Designs, campaign concepts, and SEO requests become functional pages in WordPress and HubSpot.

  • Technical audit findings lead to practical fixes, with changes tested to avoid breaking existing functionality.

  • Legacy and unused code is cleaned up thoughtfully, while essential code and front-end behavior remain intact.

  • Forms, templates, and integrations work as intended and support the client’s marketing workflows.

  • Projects stay on track because you manage your workload, meet agreed deadlines, and raise questions or blockers early.

  • Teammates have clear visibility into progress through timely updates and straightforward communication in Slack.

raw.excerpt: Bist du auf der Suche nach einer neuen Herausforderung, in der du Social Media nicht nur bespielst, sondern strategisch skalierst?
raw.description:
Bist du auf der Suche nach einer neuen Herausforderung, in der du Social Media nicht nur bespielst, sondern strategisch skalierst?

Du willst kein klassisches Agentur-Umfeld, sondern echte Ownership für starke Personal Brands im Trading- und Finance-Bereich übernehmen?

Bei uns gestaltest du Wachstum nicht mit – du verantwortest es.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Team zusammen, entwickelst skalierbare Content-Strategien und baust Social Media als messbaren Wachstumskanal aus.

Wenn du Performance liebst, Daten ernst nimmst und Social Media als strategisches Spielfeld verstehst – dann sollten wir sprechen.

Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst eine plattformübergreifende Content-Strategie für Instagram, YouTube und TikTok
  • Du planst, koordinierst und optimierst unseren Content-Kalender
  • Du konzipierst Kampagnen, Serienformate und skalierbare Content-Mechaniken
  • Du analysierst Performance-Daten und leitest konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab
  • Du führst A/B-Tests für Hooks, Thumbnails, Titel und Formate durch
  • Du identifizierst Trends frühzeitig und übersetzt sie in performante Content-Ideen
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Video Editor zusammen und steuerst die Content-Produktion strategisch
  • Du entwickelst Engagement- und Community-Strategien
  • Du definierst klare Wachstumsziele und trackst deren Erreichung

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung:
    Du hast bereits nachweisbare Erfolge im Social Media Management erzielt – idealerweise im Educational-, Trading- oder Finance-Umfeld.
  • Mindset:
    Growth ist für dich kein Buzzword. Du denkst in KPIs, Conversion, Retention und Skalierung.
  • Plattform-Verständnis:
    Du verstehst die Algorithmen von Instagram, YouTube und TikTok nicht nur oberflächlich, sondern strategisch.
  • Analytik:
    Du arbeitest sicher mit Analytics-Tools wie Instagram Insights, YouTube Analytics etc. und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungen ab.
  • Strategie + Kreativität:
    Du kannst virale Ideen entwickeln – aber immer mit einem klaren strategischen Ziel.
  • Arbeitsweise:
    Eigenständig, strukturiert, verantwortungsvoll. Kein Micromanagement nötig.

Benefits

  • Volle Verantwortung für spannende Kanäle mit Wachstumspotenzial
  • Ein Team aus Top-Performern und Gründer:innen, das gemeinsam auf Wachstum setzt.
  • Eine Kultur, die Verantwortung, Höchstleistungen und Ehrlichkeit schätzt – hier zählt, was du erreichst, nicht nur, was du sagst.
  • Mental- & Physical Health wird großgeschrieben.
  • Work from anywhere, wir sind 100% remote und arbeiten mit Kunden in der deutschen Zeitzone
  • Workations? Bei uns gehören sie dazu und werden von uns gelebt.
  • Raum für Experimente, Learnings & persönliche Weiterentwicklung

Hat dich das überzeugt ?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt und starte bald gemeinsam mit uns durch! Lade einfach deinen Lebenslauf hoch – ein Anschreiben oder Zeugnisse sind überflüssig. Wir halten es lieber unkompliziert.

Bewerbungseingang: Sobald deine Bewerbung bei uns eingeht, erhältst du eine kurze Bestätigung – du kannst dir sicher sein, dass wir deine Unterlagen sorgfältig prüfen.

Get-to-know-Call: Passt dein Profil, laden wir dich zu einem ersten Videocall (ca. 30 min.) ein. Hier finden wir gemeinsam heraus, ob es vom Mindset passt – und du bekommst erste Insights in unsere einzigartige Arbeitskultur.

Competence-Call: Als nächstes lernst du deinen Teamlead kennen. In einem 60–75-minütigen Gespräch sprechen wir über deine fachlichen und persönlichen Stärken – und finden gemeinsam heraus, ob es ein Match zwischen uns gibt. Nach dem Call bekommst du schnellstmöglich unser Feedback.

Founder Call: Zum Abschluss möchte dich unser Co-Founder Sam persönlich kennenlernen (ca. 30 min.). Keine Sorge – du bekommst innerhalb von 2 Tagen Feedback. Wenn alles passt, starten wir gemeinsam durch!

About HireHawk

HireHawk connects skilled professionals with US companies for long-term remote roles. We are looking for proactive people who take ownership of their work and want to grow with a stable team.

About the role

Our client is an established plaintiff personal injury firm in Los Angeles that focuses on premises liability cases (slip-and-fall and trip-and-fall). Its cases are worked up in litigation for full value, so complete medical documentation matters on every file.

You will be the records specialist for a group of case managers. Your job is to request medical records and bills for their cases and follow up until every file is complete.

Responsibilities

  • Request medical records, medical bills and related documents from hospitals, clinics, imaging centers and other providers.
  • Follow up consistently on outstanding requests until the records arrive.
  • Upload, label and organize documents in the firm's case management software.
  • Keep a tracking log of pending requests and follow-ups so the case managers can see what is missing.
  • Flag documentation gaps on each case to the assigned case manager.
  • Send and track HIPAA authorizations and other records release forms.
  • Process incoming faxes and electronic records and route them to the right file.
  • Protect client confidentiality at all times.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • Experience at a US personal injury law firm requesting medical records and medical bills.
  • Strong written and spoken English, for calls and emails with medical providers.
  • Organized and persistent, able to handle a high volume of requests and follow-ups across many cases on your own.
  • Comfortable with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace and a legal case management platform.
  • Full-time availability during US Pacific business hours, with reliable internet and a dedicated workspace.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience supporting several case managers at once.
  • Premises liability case experience.
  • Experience working through remote desktop access to a firm's systems.

Symbria Rx Services is seeking a team oriented, experienced Senior Pharmacy Data Entry Technician who shares our commitment to ensuring the health and wellness of seniors. As one of the few 100% employee-owned companies in healthcare, our business practices are guided strictly by the values to which our employee owners are committed to. For more than 20 years, Symbria has been providing an outstanding work environment for talented employees to deliver patient-centered care to the geriatric population in senior-living and post-acute settings.

Position Summary

The primary purpose of this position is computer data entry of prescription orders and medical records.

Position Details:

  • Multiple shifts available
  • Rotating weekends and holidays. Those hours will depend on needs.
  • FrameWorks LTC Experience required, Docutrack preferred

Responsibilities

  • Contact physician’s office as needed for refill authorization.
  • Contact client for verification of orders as needed.
  • Process all new and refill prescriptions.
  • Open orders as needed, verify eligibility, proof and input prescriptions while maintaining productivity and quality standards.
  • Document correspondence and follow up in the system.
  • Prepare audit sheets and provide feedback to manager.
  • Forward incomplete or rejected scripts to appropriate department for resolution and track status in the system.
  • Initiate and document correspondence and follow up in system.
  • May assist with research of lost or missing orders per internal department requests.

Qualifications

  • High School diploma or general education degree (GED).
  • Pharmacy Technician license and Certification (CPhT) as per state requirements.
  • Long-term care pharmacy experience preferred.
  • Frameworks and Docutrack experience preferred.
  • Ability to work in a flexible schedule as operational needs dictate, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

Qualifications Preferred:

  • Pharmacy data entry experience; minimum one year.
  • Strong knowledge of Brand/Generic drugs and medical terminology.

New employees will have 60 days from their hire date to obtain all state-required Pharmacy Technician licenses and six months from their hire date to obtain their Pharmacy Technician National Certification, if they don't already.

Why work for us?

We are a100% employee-owned company through an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). You, along with your co-workers, have an ownership stake in this company! For more than 20 years, Symbria has been providing an outstanding work environment for talented employees to deliver patient-centered care to the geriatric population in senior-living and post-acute settings.

raw.title: Distributed Systems Engineer (L4) - Data Platform
raw.excerpt: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world.
raw.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

The Data Platform teams at Netflix enable us to leverage data to bring joy to our members in many different ways. We provide centralized data platforms and tools for various business functions at Netflix, so they can utilize our data to make critical data-driven decisions. We do all the heavy lifting to make it easy for our business partners to work with data efficiently, securely, and responsibly. We aspire to lead the industry standard in building a world-class data infrastructure, as Netflix leads the way to be the most popular and pervasive destination for global internet entertainment.

We are looking for distributed systems engineers to help evolve and innovate our infrastructure. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that will bring new perspectives as we solve the next set of challenges. In addition, we are open to remote candidates. We value what you can do from anywhere in the U.S.

Spotlight on Data Platform Teams:

Storage and Movement Infrastructure

The Storage and Movement Infrastructure (SMI) team builds the core infrastructure that powers Netflix’s online data stores and data movement systems. Our mission is to amplify the effectiveness of these teams by delivering secure, scalable, and high‑leverage infrastructure abstractions that minimize duplicated effort, reduce operational risk, and accelerate time‑to‑delivery for Tier‑0, low‑latency, highly available services. We identify common challenges across Online Data Stores and Data Movement platforms—such as fleet management, schema management, control planes, security, and reliability—and turn them into shared, foundational primitives.

As part of SMI, you’ll work on platforms that sit at the heart of Netflix’s data ecosystem: a unified Schema Management Platform for Protobuf and Avro; a Fleet Management Platform for CI/CD and large stateful/stateless fleets; core Control Plane infrastructure for capacity, provisioning, and operations; and security and access management via consistent authentication/authorization layers. You’ll also help build resilience and reliability tooling, including SLI/SLO enablement, and a Fault Management platform for large fleets. This is a high‑impact, cross‑pillar team that partners closely with both Online Data Stores and Data Movement, shaping the paved path for how data services are operated at scale at Netflix.

Data Movement Platform - Abstractions

Provides a self-service, abstracted platform that empowers diverse user groups across Netflix to fulfill their data movement and processing needs. We own and operate Data Mesh and Data Bridge. They are the paved paths for real-time and batch data movement and transformation, with huge adoption among many teams at Netflix. We also focus on operational automation, reliability and data consistency. You will have the opportunity to work on a massive distributed system that operates thousands of pipelines and processes billions of records per second.

KeyValue

The KeyValue team (part of the Online Data Stores portfolio) offers a managed key value store to meet Netflix's operational data requirements across all lines of business. Our focus is on developing and maintaining a high-performance, reliable, and efficient key-value store. Additionally, we enhance developer productivity by providing a secure, intuitive and opinionated access layer for our backing storage engines including Cassandra.

This team is passionate about building innovative, efficient, performant and scalable offerings for our customers. Our team also engages with the Cassandra open source community, actively contributing to and responsibly stewarding the development and use of open source software.

Data Developer Experience

The Data Developer Experience (DDX) team at Netflix is dedicated to enhancing the experience of data practitioners—including Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, ML Engineers, and Data Scientists. As we evolve toward the next generation of our data platform, the DDX team is focused on boosting productivity by developing cutting-edge data tools and infrastructure that eliminate the friction and toil of building, maintaining, and leveraging data products. If you're passionate about shaping the future of developer experience, making it faster and easier for Netflix data practitioners to deliver outstanding data products, come join our team!

This would be your dream job if you enjoy:

  • Solving real business needs at large scale by applying your software engineering and analytical problem-solving skills.

  • Architecting and building a robust, scalable, and highly available distributed infrastructure.

  • Leading cross-functional initiatives and collaborating with engineers, product managers, and TPM across teams.

  • Sharing our experiences with the open source communities and contributing to Netflix OSS.

About you:

  • You have 2+ years of experience in building large-scale distributed systems features or applications.

  • You are proficient in the design and development of RESTful web services.

  • Experienced in building and operating scalable, fault-tolerant, distributed systems

  • You are experienced in Java or other object-oriented programming languages.

  • Multi-threading is a challenge that you are comfortable tackling.

  • You have a BS in Computer Science or a related field.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $71,040.00 - $464,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.

Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.

Inclusionis a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

Job is open for no less than 7 days and will be removed when the position is filled.

One of the most critical parts of this evolution is the foundation upon which we can scale personalized and inclusive experiences for the workforce.

Our Talent AI team is focused on helping to drive change at scale. The team is fundamentally helping to find ways to drive AI powered solutions in how we attract, develop, and retain the extraordinary people who power our business, while also helping to drive greater AI adoption and fluency across Talent. This team is critical in identifying, prototyping, and shipping AI-powered capabilities across the full Talent lifecycle. The team works closely with all functional areas across Talent — as well as Netflix's central AI teams.

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Applied AI Lead who can bridge the gap between Talent's biggest opportunities and what is possible with today's AI tools. This person can both envision high-impact solutions and build working prototypes that turn ideas into something stakeholders can actually touch and react to — before a single engineer is engaged.

This is not a traditional product manager role or an engineering role. It sits in the space between: someone with strong Talent domain expertise and genuine AI fluency who moves fast, exercises high judgment about what is worth building, and knows how to take a prototype all the way to a production partnership with engineering.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Owning outcomes, not just outputs — staying engaged through deployment and adoption to ensure the solution actually delivers value.

  • Evaluating AI tools, platforms, and vendors with rigor — building a clear point of view on what to adopt off-the-shelf, what to integrate, and what to build custom.

  • Developing other Talent team members' AI fluency through hands-on sessions, shared examples, and clear frameworks for when and how to use AI.

  • Ensuring every AI solution is designed with appropriate data privacy, security, and fairness considerations — partnering with Legal, Infosec, and other teams from the start, not at the end.

  • Partner with central teams to develop a system for tracking and monitoring AI tool engagement, fluency, and business outcomes.

Country Manager Kenya

As Country Manager Kenya, you understand the crucial role strong business ecosystems play in driving economic growth, social inclusion, and sustainable development. You bring a solid local network of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and partners, combined with proven experience in programme management and team leadership. Do you thrive on building meaningful partnerships, leading a result-driven team, and creating lasting impact across your country? This is your opportunity!

About PUM

PUM is a unique organisation committed to making a positive impact on a global scale. With a network of 1,200 skilled voluntary experts, we collaborate with ambitious entrepreneurs in 26 countries and 12 programmes, sharing expertise to strengthen business ecosystems and create economic, social, and environmental value. We work closely with SMEs, as well as the organisations that support them. We believe in the power of collaboration and in the magic that happens when diverse perspectives come together; Together we grow!

The role

You will lead the country acquisition team in Kenya consisting of 7Country Representatives on a freelance basis who engage change-driven SMEs to participate in PUM's impactful programmes. You hold end-to-end responsibility for client relationship management after acquisition, ensuring continuity, quality of engagement, and strategic alignment. You will be part of the Africa regional team, reporting to the head of region and collaborating closely with 15 other country managers in the region, 12 programme managers, as well as other departments such as recruitment and communications & partnerships. Your daily activities will be varied and challenging:

  • You develop and implement the Country Impact Plan (CIP) in line with PUM’s mission, strategy, and organisational ambitions.

  • You center on strengthening business ecosystems, based on strategic analysis and in line with PUM’s programmes. You are able to establish partnerships and collaborate with wider networks of entrepreneurs, business organisations and other enabling organisations to advance business ecosystems.

  • You identify, develop, and secure funding opportunities from institutional donors, foundations, corporate partners, and other possible sponsors, contributing to the sustainability and growth of PUM's impact in Kenya.

  • You foster strategic partnerships with SMEs and stakeholders through proactive account management and ongoing engagement, building trust and long-term impact, while expanding PUM's visibility, credibility and country influence.

  • You build, lead, and coach the country representative team, safeguarding the quality and continuity of acquisition.

  • You ensure team capacity, motivation, accountability, and performance through effective people management, including organising country team meetings (CTMs).

  • You qualify new clients using assessment criteria that emphasise diversity, inclusion, and alignment with PUM’s green and social goals within business ecosystems.

  • You approve project proposals, ensuring accurate and complete information so programme managers can identify the right expert match.

  • You collaborate closely with programme managers to ensure alignment, shared goals, and successful projects. Occasionally, you will welcome and accompany visiting experts.

  • You personally engage with clients after acquisition, ensuring continuity, quality of engagement, and strategic fit.

  • You lead professional briefing and debriefing sessions to ensure quality assurance, data collection, and learning.

  • You monitor performance and use data to share insights and improve results. 

  • You ensure compliance with organisational policies, quality standards, and project timelines.

Who are you?

As Country Manager, you combine strategic vision with operational excellence. You understand the challenges that local SMEs face and know how to translate entrepreneurial ambition into tangible impact. Does this sound like you?

  • You are a proactive, hands-on and strategic thinker with a bachelor's or master's degree.

  • You bring at least 10 years of experience in a coordinating role and leading a commercial or acquisition-focused team.

  • You bring in strong fundraising capabilities through a thorough understanding of local donor opportunities.

  • You have a strong local SME network and a deep understanding of business ecosystem development in your country.

  • You are familiar with European work culture and experienced in remote collaboration within international organisations.

  • You demonstrate strong intercultural communication skills and collaborate effectively across departments and stakeholders.

  • You have proven leadership and accountability skills, with experience in performance management and stakeholder engagement.

  • You are experienced in managing a remote team operating across the country.

  • You are willing to travel occasionally within Kenya for project development visits, partnership meetings, and country team meetings.

  • You are strongly focused on impact, quality, and measurable results.

  • You thrive in an organisation in growth and transition and enjoy contributing to further professionalisation.

  • You are data-driven and comfortable using digital tools, including Microsoft 365.

  • You have excellent command of English; fluency in other local languages such as Swahili is a plus.

  • You are permanently based in Kenya, preferably in Nairobi, and available for 37.5 hours per week

What we offer

raw.title: Plant Controller Project Lead
raw.excerpt: Leidos Engineering has an opportunity for an experienced Project Lead to direct the engineering design of a high-profile plant controller and plant-wide SCADA program for a large behind-the-meter hybrid energy facility in the ERCOT market.
raw.description:
Leidos Engineering has an opportunity for an experienced Project Lead to direct the engineering design of a high-profile plant controller and plant-wide SCADA program for a large behind-the-meter hybrid energy facility in the ERCOT market. The facility combines utility-scale wind and solar generation with a mission-critical AI data center load, connected to the grid through dual 345 kV points of interconnection.


The Project Lead will work alongside the Project Manager and program leadership within Leidos Energy. You will be the technical owner of the design: directing a multidisciplinary team of controls, SCADA/HMI, OT cybersecurity, and power systems studies engineers and specialty subcontractors, integrating their work into a coordinated design, and serving as the lead technical voice to the EPC client, equipment vendors, and the owner’s engineers from detailed design through commissioning.


About the Project:

The site-level plant controller is the real-time orchestration layer for the facility, issuing validated setpoints, constraints, and priorities to downstream asset controllers while respecting vendor-certified control logic. Its objectives are to:

  • Define and enforce a reliable, predictable operating envelope for the mission-critical data center load
  • Dispatch wind and solar generation to regulate voltage, frequency, and apparent power at the dual points of interconnection in line with ERCOT and interconnection requirements
  • Coordinate with wind and solar power plant controllers, capacitor banks, and transformer tap changers to regulate the POI and protect equipment ratings
  • Maximize use of on-site renewable generation and minimize unnecessary curtailment
  • Report key performance indicators for the POI, generation, and load assets through SCADA, HMI, and historian systems
  • Provide a secure, NERC CIP-ready architecture that can integrate future battery storage and natural gas generation without redesign

This is a permanent, salaried position with Leidos. While this role will focus on one particular project, there is no projected end date for this position, and the selected individual can expect to take part in ongoing Leidos projects in the future. The salary pay range for this postion is between 175 - 225k USD, depending on the selected candidate's experience and qualifications.


As a Leidos employee, you can look forward to a fast-paced, diverse work environment and flexible work hours/work arrangements, as well as managers who will encourage career development and growth opportunities, including:

  • Professional Engineer (PE) licensure and Project Management Professional (PMP) certification support
  • Formal Mentorship programs
  • Learning & Development Resources
  • Continuing Education Programs
  • Technical leadership tracks and project management opportunities

In this role, you can expect to:

  • Serve as technical owner of the plant control and SCADA design across the project lifecycle, from requirements and concept of operations through detailed design, testing, commissioning, and closeout
  • Direct engineering leads for controls, SCADA/HMI, OT networking and cybersecurity, and power systems studies, integrating their work into one coordinated design
  • Develop requirements, use cases, control narratives, and control algorithms for plant-level functions such as voltage and reactive power regulation, frequency response, POI and equipment limit control, and load coordination
  • Apply power system modeling and study results to define control limits, operating envelopes, and equipment sizing
  • Develop and manage interface specifications with third-party controllers, OEMs, utilities, and other stakeholders, and resolve technical conflicts between parties
  • Ensure the design supports grid operator interconnection requirements and applicable NERC standards
  • Lead technical quality reviews of engineering deliverables, including studies, drawings, specifications, points lists, network designs, and test plans
  • Partner with the Project Manager on engineering budget, schedule, and staffing, providing estimates to complete, early warning of scope changes, and technical input to change orders
  • Define hardware and software requirements and review bills of material for control and network equipment
  • Lead technical responses to RFIs and submittals during construction
  • Plan and lead factory acceptance and hardware-in-the-loop testing, author commissioning test plans, and serve as technical lead during site commissioning and compliance testing
  • Represent Leidos in technical design reviews and coordination meetings with clients, vendors, and owner’s engineers
  • Ensure the engineering team follows project cybersecurity and critical infrastructure information handling requirements
  • Mentor project engineers and support operator training and knowledge transfer at turnover

What You'll Bring to the Table (Required Qualifications):

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering; Controls, Computer, or Power Systems Engineering may be considered
  • A minimum of eight (8) years of engineering experience in the electric power industry, including at least four (4) years leading multidisciplinary design teams
  • Demonstrated technical leadership of utility-scale power plant controller, SCADA, or substation automation projects from design through commissioning
  • Hands-on experience with plant-level control functions such as voltage/VAR regulation, primary frequency response, curtailment, and POI limit control for inverter-based resources
  • Working knowledge of ERCOT interconnection requirements and applicable NERC standards (e.g., PRC-024/029, MOD-025/026/027, CIP)
  • Experience developing or reviewing interface specifications with third-party PPC, OEM, and utility equipment, including communication protocols (DNP3, Modbus, IEEE C37.118, IEC 61850)
  • Ability to interpret power system study results and apply them to control design and operating limits
  • Experience with design review processes and quality control of engineering deliverables
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including presenting technical positions to clients and vendors
  • Experience with MS Office Software (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
  • Ability to meet client background screening and site access requirements
  • Periodic travel to Texas is required, so candidates should be available for travel as needed

You Might Also Have (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license, or the ability to obtain one, with Texas licensure a plus
  • Experience with hybrid plants, co-located large loads, or data center interconnections, including behind-the-meter configurations
  • Hands-on experience with SEL RTAC/SEL-3555 programming and Ignition SCADA, HMI, and historian development
  • Experience integrating Vestas, TMEIC, or similar wind and solar power plant controllers
  • Experience with power systems modeling (PSS/E, PSCAD, ETAP) and real-time simulation for CHIL testing (OPAL-RT, RTDS)
  • Knowledge of OT cybersecurity design (NERC CIP, IEC 62443, next-generation firewalls, jump host architectures, network segmentation)
  • Experience supporting ERCOT resource commissioning, QSE telemetry, or market qualification testing
  • Experience planning for future BESS or gas generation integration in plant control architectures
  • Experience working on EPC or design-build projects and supporting construction operations
  • Familiarity with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, P6, Procore) and engineering budget tracking
  • Excellent organizational skills and the ability to multi-task effectively
  • Aptitude for problem solving and critical thinking

The salary pay range for this postion is between 175 - 225k USD, depending on the selected candidate's experience and qualifications.

raw.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

The Key Account Manager is responsible for managing, retaining and growing BESA contractor membership within their allocated geographical area.

The role acts as the main relationship lead for contractor members, ensuring they receive clear value from BESA, understand the support available to them, and remain engaged throughout their membership.

The role is also responsible for identifying and developing growth opportunities. This includes new contractor membership opportunities, Member Pledge opportunities, member referrals, supply chain opportunities and wider engagement.

This is a commercial relationship role. It combines account management, retention, engagement and growth.

Candidates must reside in Wales and have a strong connection to the country, with the credibility, knowledge and professional networks needed to engage effectively and represent BESA across Wales.

KEY DUTIES

Account management and retention

  • Manage a portfolio of allocated contractor members.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key contacts across member businesses, including owners, directors, commercial leads, technical leads, operations leads and compliance contacts.

  • Understand each member’s business, priorities, challenges and current use of BESA business support services.

  • Identify retention risks early and take action before membership renewal becomes a concern.

  • Ensure the member portfolio is fully aware and up to date with their BESA Competence Assessment Standard (CAS) Audits.

  • Maintain regular contact with priority members and ensure meaningful engagement is recorded in iMIS.

  • Ensure members understand and access relevant:

  • BESA business support - Technical, Employment, Health and Safety, Legal & Commercial, Training & Skills

  • Engagement activity – Region & Nation meetings, Specialist Group and Committee meetings and Business Networking Events

  • Additional Certificate Schemes and Benefits - REFCOM, VHR, SFG20, Welplan and wider BESA Group services where relevant.

Growth and new membership

  • Identify and develop new contractor membership opportunities within the allocated region or account base.

  • Prioritise contractor businesses that are active in BESA in-scope work areas and have clear potential for membership.

  • Support regional growth through Member Pledge, member referrals, supply chain opportunities, former members, event leads and warm introductions.

  • Progress suitable opportunities directly or hand them over to the sales team where appropriate.

  • Track all opportunities in iMIS, including owner, stage, likely band, revenue value where known, next action and source.

Member Pledge activity

  • Identify members who may be suitable to sign and commit to the BESA Member Pledge.

  • Support signed Member Pledge relationships where the business has agreed to the principles and the document is signed by the CEO, MD or equivalent senior decision-maker.

  • Work with Membership Operations to ensure supply chain lists are cleaned, mapped, uploaded and tagged correctly in iMIS.

  • Support the conversion of suitable supply chain contractors into full BESA contractor membership.

Regional engagement

raw.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Dans le cadre de la dématérialisation de procédures métiers liées au classement, à la restauration et aux subventions de biens patrimoniaux, un programme de transformation prévoit la mise en place d’une plateforme intégrée de gestion interne, de référentiels et de publication de données.

Cette plateforme doit couvrir l’ensemble du cycle de vie d’un dossier et s’interfacer avec plusieurs applications régionales et fédérales afin d’assurer un parcours utilisateur complet. Elle est développée sur Odoo et interagira avec d’autres modules, notamment un site web, des composants géomatiques et une plateforme d’échange.

La mission consiste à soutenir la coordination des tests métier et fonctionnels avec une approche de testing applicatif end-to-end sur la plateforme et ses intégrations. L’objectif est de garantir la qualité et l’exhaustivité des scénarios de test, d’exécuter les tests en amont des utilisateurs métier et de faire remonter les résultats en vue des corrections et améliorations.

Vous intervenez dès le démarrage du projet et collaborez avec les chefs de projet, la coordination du programme, les responsables qualité et tests, ainsi qu’avec les équipes métier impliquées.

Vos principales responsabilités sont les suivantes :

  • mettre en place un cadre de testing métier avec les testeurs concernés, incluant la méthode, la gouvernance, les livrables et l’organisation des tests ;
  • assister la coordination des tests dans la définition, la structuration et la rédaction des scénarios de tests fonctionnels ;
  • élaborer les plans de test de conformité et de non-régression pour l’ensemble de la plateforme et de ses interfaces ;
  • rédiger et maintenir les scénarios de test dans Xray sous Jira ;
  • exécuter les tests applicatifs et assurer le suivi des plans de test, des résultats et des rapports ;
  • identifier les anomalies et non-conformités, puis les communiquer à l’équipe en charge de leur traitement ;
  • participer à la communauté de pratique des testeurs ;
  • intervenir, selon les besoins, sur des tests d’intégration et de performance ;
  • utiliser des outils de test dédiés, par exemple SOAPUI, et contribuer à des actions d’automatisation, notamment avec Playwright.

📝 Votre profil

Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée en tant que testeur applicatif.

  • Très bonne compréhension technique et fonctionnelle d’une application et de ses intégrations.
  • Capacité à restituer des aspects techniques par écrit de manière simple et compréhensible.
  • Expérience dans l’exécution de tests informatiques, y compris la rédaction de plans de test, l’exécution, le suivi, le reporting et la gestion des anomalies.
  • Maîtrise de la gestion de tests de conformité, d’intégration, de non-régression et de performance.
  • Bonne connaissance de Jira et Xray.
  • Pratique d’un environnement de test dédié, par exemple SOAPUI, avec compréhension de sa technicité.
  • Connaissance de Scrum et du travail en contexte agile.
  • Des connaissances en automatisation de tests, par exemple avec Playwright, constituent un atout.
  • Très bonnes capacités rédactionnelles.
  • Vous travaillez avec autonomie, rigueur, structure et sens du formalisme.
  • Vous faites preuve de proactivité, d’esprit d’équipe et d’une démarche d’amélioration continue.
  • Vous savez collaborer avec des interlocuteurs métier exigeants, avec diplomatie.
  • Le français est requis.

METHODE D EVALUATION

Les candidats retenus seront conviés à un entretien devant un jury, dont la composition sera communiquée ultérieurement.

L’entretien pourrait avoir lieu à distance si les circonstances le nécessitent.

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

raw.excerpt: About High ScaleWe’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media.
raw.description:
About High Scale

We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026—and we need an Audiovisual Producer (Realizador Audiovisual) who is a master of the entire post-production spectrum, blending storytelling, rhythm, and sound into a cohesive masterpiece.

Why This Role Matters

Holistic storytelling, sensory impact, and creative autonomy are your playground. In this role, you aren't just an "editor"—you are a creator. You will take ownership of the entire audiovisual experience, from the narrative cut to the sound design, color grade, and motion graphics.

This role is designed for the "Preditor" (Producer/Editor)—the multifaceted talent common in the LATAM market who can take a folder of raw assets and turn it into a broadcast-ready commercial without needing to pass it to three other departments. If you thrive on owning the final product and crafting the full sensory experience, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

  1. Execute End-to-End Post-Production

    • Take ownership of video projects from ingest to final export. You will be responsible for the edit, the sound mix, the color balance, and the motion graphics.

    • Transform raw studio footage and UGC into dynamic, high-performance ads for Social Media (TikTok/Reels) and Connected TV.

  2. Master Audio & Sound Design

    • Go beyond simple music sync. Use sound effects (SFX), foley, and dynamic audio mixing to drive the pacing and emotion of the edit.

    • Select and edit music tracks to create the perfect "vibe" that aligns with the brand's identity.

  3. Implement Visual Polish (Motion & Color)

    • Apply polished motion graphics (kinetic text, logo builds) to reinforce the message.

    • Perform creative color grading to ensure the video looks premium and consistent with the brand's aesthetic.

  4. Creative Conceptualization

    • Work with the creative team to propose visual solutions. You don't just follow a script; you propose cuts, transitions, and effects that elevate the concept.

    • Adapt and iterate on successful concepts to create new "winning" variations.

Who You Are

  1. A True "Realizador Audiovisual"

    • 3–6 years of experience in a generalist post-production role (agency, production house, or freelance).

    • You are comfortable wearing multiple hats: Editor, Sound Designer, Colorist, and Motion Designer.

  2. Technical Generalist

    • Mastery of Adobe Premiere Pro is non-negotiable.

    • Strong proficiency in After Effects (for graphics), Audition (for sound), and DaVinci/Lumetri (for color).

    • You understand codecs, bitrates, and export settings for every platform.

  3. A Rhythm Master

    • Your edits have a heartbeat. You understand how to cut to music and how to use pacing to keep a viewer engaged for the full 30 seconds.

  4. Detail-Oriented & Organized

    • You manage your own projects and timelines effectively.

    • You are meticulous about Quality Control (QC)—no flash frames, no audio peaks, no typos.

  5. Bilingual Communicator

    • Strong English proficiency (C1/C2) is required. You will be collaborating with US-based producers and must be able to articulate creative choices clearly in English.

Perks & Benefits

  • Growth Opportunities: Influence the creative direction of global brands and lead complex audiovisual projects.

  • Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world—one stunning frame at a time.

raw.description:
ABOUT SLATE

At Slate, we’re building safe, reliable vehicles that people can afford, personalize and love—and doing it here in the USA as part of our commitment to reindustrialization. The spirit of DIY and customization runs throughout every element of a Slate, because people should have control over how their trucks look, feel, and represent them.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
We’re looking for a Frontend Software Development Engineer II to help define and build Slate’s digital customer experience. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving real problems, building high-quality user interfaces, and owning systems end-to-end.

You should be comfortable working in a startup environment where priorities evolve, requirements aren’t always fully defined, and thoughtful engineering judgment matters more than rigid process. If ambiguity energizes you rather than slows you down, you’ll thrive here.

WHAT YOU GET TO DO

  • Design, build, and deliver customer-facing web/mobile experiences that are performant, reliable, and intuitive

  • Lead the implementation and evolution of frontend systems, including component design, state management, and UI architecture

  • Write clean, well-structured code and actively participate in code reviews and technical design discussions

  • Own code quality end-to-end, including testing, edge-case handling, and production readiness

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and UX partners to translate customer needs into elegant technical solutions

  • Make thoughtful trade-offs between speed, quality, and long-term maintainability—and clearly communicate those decisions

  • Continuously simplify and improve systems, demonstrating strong judgment, creativity, and attention to detail

  • Mentor other engineers through example, feedback, and technical discussion, contributing to a strong engineering culture

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TEAM

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong emphasis on frontend or customer-facing web development

  • Strong proficiency in modern frontend languages, ideally TypeScript, React and JavaScript, with solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and problem decomposition

  • Experience building and maintaining production UI systems, including performance optimization, accessibility, and cross-browser compatibility

  • 3+ years contributing to frontend architecture and design, including patterns for maintainability, reliability, and scalability

  • 3+ years working across the full software development lifecycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control, build tooling, testing, and operational support

  • Familiarity working in cloud-backed environments (e.g., integrating with APIs, CI/CD pipelines, AWS and/or Azure), with an understanding of how frontend systems behave in production

  • Strong communication skills: you ask clarifying questions, state assumptions, identify constraints, and explain your thinking clearly—especially when requirements are ambiguous

Work Authorization Requirement
Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship at this time.

Salary Range

The compensation for this position is the range Slate reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position taking into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including job-related knowledge; skillset; experience, education and training; certifications; work location; and other relevant business and organizational factors.

Base Pay Range (Annual)

119,662.00 - 179,493.00 USD Annual

Additional Compensation and Benefits: Slate offers a wide range of competitive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability insurance, vacation, and 401k. The successful candidate may also be eligible to participate in the equity program and/or a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing such programs.

WHY JOIN TEAM SLATE?

At Slate, we’re fueled by grit, determination, and attention to detail. The start-up spirit of ingenuity and resourcefulness move our business forward. Team Slate fosters a culture of excellence, innovation, and mutual respect, and is motivated by shared principles.

  • Safety First

  • Delight Customers

  • One Team

  • Relentless Improvement

  • Fast, Frugal, and Scrappy

  • Respectful Collaboration

  • Positive Legacy

WE WANT TO WORK WITH PEOPLE THAT REFLECT THE COMMUNITIES IN WHICH WE OPERATE.

Slate is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, parental status, cultural background, organizational level, work styles, tenure and life experiences. Or for any other reason.

raw.title: Senior Analyst, Data & Analytics (Pharmacy Analytics & Reporting) - REMOTE
raw.excerpt: JOB DESCRIPTION Job SummaryProvides senior level analyst support for data analysis and reporting activities.
raw.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Summary

Provides senior level analyst support for data analysis and reporting activities. Responsible for organizing data from multiple sources to produce reports, dashboards, and analyses related to utilization, cost-containment, and business performance. Generates data-related insights that support strategic and operational decision-making and cost-containment. Designs and delivers reporting, analytics, and data solutions across business and healthcare domains, including claims, utilization, finance, and other business areas. Partners with stakeholders to define requirements, develop scalable reporting and data processes, and apply advanced analytical techniques to identify trends, forecast outcomes, and drive business performance. Supports projects, regulatory requests, and initiatives that improve data quality, reporting workflows, and process efficiencies.

Essential Job Duties

  • Analyzes complex datasets from multiple sources to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities.
    • Designs, develops, and maintains reports, dashboards, and data solutions using tools such as Structured Query Language (SQL), Microsoft Excel, and SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), that support utilization analysis, cost-containment, and operational performance.
    • Translates business needs into reporting and analytical requirements; partners with stakeholders to deliver actionable insights.
    • Facilitates healthcare data analysis, including data related to claims, pharmacy, lab, utilization, cost, and other areas.
    • Develops and maintains data processes for extraction, transformation, validation, and integration.
    • Ensures data accuracy, integrity, and consistency through quality assurance and validation processes.
    • Creates forecasts, models, and recommendations based on statistical analysis and business context.
    • Organizes, documents, and maintains datasets and reporting workflows across multiple business areas.
    • Consolidates research and analysis into clear summaries and recommendations for business stakeholders.
    • Supports regulatory, contractual, and enterprise reporting requirements, including state mandated submissions.
    • Identifies and implements enhancements or fixes to existing reports and reporting processes.
    • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to define reporting requirements and maintain project/report timelines.
    • Documents methodologies, reporting processes, and business requirements.
    • Identifies and drives process improvements, standardization, and automation opportunities.
    • Leads or supports projects, including timeline management, requirements gathering, and deliverable execution.
    • Presents findings and recommendations to leadership and cross-functional teams.
    • Supports regulatory, audit, and ad hoc data requests as needed.
    • Provides training and support to new and existing data analysis team members.

    Required Qualifications
  • At least 4 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or healthcare analytics, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
    • Analytical problem-solving skills, including ability to interpret complex datasets, identify patterns, and translate findings into actionable insights.
    • Technical proficiency with SQL, Excel, and reporting/analytics tools, and ability to learn new technologies quickly.
    • Experience with healthcare analytics (e.g., claims, utilization, cost containment, medical economics).
    • Experience working with complex datasets/provision of data analysis and insights.
    • Experience with healthcare utilization metrics, medical cost analysis, and performance indicators.
    • Attention to detail, accuracy in data validation, report development, and documentation.
    • Ability to work cross-functionally across a highly matrixed organization.
    • Effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to clarify requirements and present data-related findings and solutions.
    • Microsoft Office suite and applicable software programs proficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Pharmacy claims reporting experience and understanding highly preferred.
    • Proven ability to explain complex data challenges, impacts, and solutions to non-technical business partners.
    • Experience developing and delivering regulatory reporting and healthcare payer systems (e.g., PBM claim files and pharmacy formulary data).
    • Experience with SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), MedInsight, Power BI, relational databases or similar tools.
    • Familiarity with cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure data lakes) and business intelligence (BI) tools.
    • Familiarity with predictive modeling concepts and trend forecasting.

raw.description:
Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.

Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.

We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.

Purpose:

You will provide engineering support for the design of substation facilities for 69kV and above for Worley and its customers as an integral part of the Power Networks team.

Responsibilities:

Independently perform tasks that typically include:

  • Substation physical design including overall engineering and analysis for new switchyards and substations, additions and modifications.
  • Preparation of specifications and provide procurement support.
  • Preparation of engineering drawings including layout and general arrangements for all major equipment and structures required for high voltage switchyards or substation. Drawings include site plans, plan and elevation views, grounding, conduit, lighting, lightning protection and shielding, control building arrangements and details, AC station service, DC systems and Bills of Material.
  • Perform auxiliary electrical power system studies including load flow, short circuit, voltage drop, protection and coordination, ampacity, and battery sizing studies.
  • Perform substation grounding calculations and studies, lightning protection and insulation coordination, lighting, bus calculations, transformer and bus sizing calculations, fault calculations, and AC and DC auxiliary system sizing calculations.
  • Perform proposal preparation, proposal estimates, and provide input to scope documents and client presentations.
  • Work in a team-oriented environment with ability to work independently or as part of a group when and as required.
  • Responsible for the quality assurance of the documents to the applicable Worley and client standards.
  • Commitment to customer service and ability to work independently on more varied and complex tasks when required.
  • Supervise/coordinate other engineers of equal and lesser experience to successfully deliver a project. Provides technical direction to subordinate team members.
  • Complete tasks in accordance with project procedures, applicable codes and/or standards, on schedule and within budget.
  • Discuss technical problems and communicate effectively with other project personnel and outside customers.
  • Perform independent audits and reviews of technical work.
  • Perform the function of a team leader that can solve complex issues and act as a lead engineer responsible for the quality of the deliverables.
  • Interface with other departmental staff, project management, and with outside customers.
  • Ability to travel to job sites to perform site walkdown.
  • Responsible for the quality assurance of the documents to the applicable drawing standards and responsible for the proper document management procedures are followed.

What you will bring

Technical and Industry Experience:

  • Experience with power system modeling and analysis tools (e.g., ETAP, CYME, SKM).

  • Highly effective technical and practical engineering skills and ability to consistently deliver quality, accurate and timely work to Worley and its customers.

  • A sound knowledge of the fundamental requirements of the electrical engineering, and the basic requirements of other engineering fields.

  • A sound knowledge of applicable local and international standards and statutory and regulatory requirements.

  • Competent use of electrical engineering specific software.

  • Competent use of relevant software such as MS Office Suite.

  • Substantial technical land practical experience in electrical engineering in the same or similar industry including experience in working in multi-disciplinary projects and teams.

  • Experience working in project leadership role.

  • Experience in estimating project costs and writing proposal content.

  • Ideal candidate should have strong interpersonal and written communication skills that permit working efficiently alongside other senior substation engineers and designers in a team setting.

Education – Qualifications, Accreditation, Training:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering and12 or more years of experience in substation design including supervisory experience.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) in the United States.

Moving forward together

We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels they belong, can bring themselves, and are heard. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by law.

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.

Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

Regional Architect Manager

Southeast United States Region

Position Overview

The Regional Architect Manager leads a team of approximately 10 Solutions Architects in the Southeast United States, serving as both a hands-on technical leader and a people-first manager within Insight's North America Infrastructure Solutions organization. This role is part of Insight's presales Solutions Engineering and Architecture function, which designs outcome-based solutions that address complex client challenges across five core infrastructure domains:

1. Cloud, Compute & Storage

2. Security

3. Managed Services

4. AI & Automation

5. Networking, IoT & Edge

Reporting to the Regional Architect Director, who in turn reports to the Vice President of Architecture for North America Infrastructure Solutions, this manager serves as the critical link between Insight's regional sales teams and its technical delivery capabilities. The Regional Architect Manager ensures that every client engagement in the Southeast is grounded in architecturally sound, business-aligned solutions — while simultaneously building a high-performing team culture rooted in technical excellence, continuous learning, and Insight's core values of Hunger, Heart, and Harmony.

This is a true player/coach role. This leader partners closely with regional Services Sales Directors, Market Development Executive (MDE) teams, and Insight's broader go-to-market leadership to drive services-led pipeline, accelerate deal velocity, and elevate Insight's position as a trusted solutions partner across the Southeast.

Location

Fully remote with travel across the Southeast United States to support client engagements, team development, and regional sales collaboration. Additional travel may be required for national team meetings, partner summits, and industry events.

What You'll Do at Insight

Team Building & Technical Leadership

  • Build, develop, and lead a high-performing team of approximately 10 Solutions Architects in the Southeast region, organized around Insight's five infrastructure solution areas.
  • Foster a unified culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and client-first solutioning that aligns with the broader North America Architecture organization's standards.
  • Define resource allocation and coverage strategies to ensure presales capacity aligns with regional sales demand and growth priorities across the Southeast.
  • Develop career paths, technical certification strategies, and skills roadmaps to ensure your team stays ahead of evolving technology trends.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews, technical readiness assessments, and coaching sessions for direct reports, driving both individual growth and team-level performance.
  • Actively aid, educate, and support peer Architects, Consultants, and Engineers across the broader organization — serving as a force multiplier for technical knowledge.

Presales Strategy & Solution Design

  • Own the presales technical strategy for the Southeast region, ensuring architecturally sound and commercially viable solutions are brought to every client engagement.
  • Partner with regional Services Sales Directors and MDE teams to qualify opportunities, shape deal strategy, and deliver compelling technical proposals and presentations.
  • Drive the adoption and regional customization of repeatable solution frameworks, reference architectures, and reusable assets across all five solution areas to accelerate time-to-proposal.
  • Establish and uphold standards of excellence for solution design, scoping accuracy, and technical proposal quality across the Southeast Architecture team.
  • Ensure all proposed solutions align with Insight's outcome-based services approach — translating technical capabilities into measurable business outcomes for clients.
  • Develop Insight proposals that dissect complex business and technical challenges and present clear, actionable solutions.

Client Engagement & Trusted Advisory

  • Own the overall technical relationship (trusted advisor) with pre-assigned accounts and other clients as needs arise across the Southeast region.
  • Build trusted advisor relationships with senior IT leaders and key technical stakeholders at Insight's strategic accounts in the region.
  • Lead and participate in architectural workshops, discovery sessions, and whiteboarding engagements for enterprise and strategic accounts.
  • Identify client business and technical requirements for opportunities, championing technical solutions that provide the client the best chance of success.
  • Travel across the Southeast to support your team on complex, multi-domain opportunities and provide hands-on technical leadership on high-profile pursuits.
  • Represent Insight at regional industry events, partner summits, and executive forums as a thought leader in modern infrastructure solutions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Delivery, Managed Services, and Professional Services leadership to ensure seamless handoff from presales design to implementation and ongoing operations.
  • Collaborate with OEM and technology partners (e.g., hyperscalers, security vendors, networking/edge providers) to influence joint solutions and drive co-selling motions.
  • Align with regional sales leadership, including Area VPs and General Managers, to ensure presales architecture resources are strategically deployed against the highest-value opportunities.
  • Work closely with Field Marketing, Solutions Marketing, and Product teams to contribute to thought leadership content, client-facing collateral, and demand generation initiatives.
  • Provide technical input on major proposals, RFP responses, and strategic pursuits across the Southeast region.

Innovation, Strategy & Market Intelligence

  • Stay at the forefront of industry trends across cloud, security, AI/automation, managed services, and networking/IoT/edge — translating market shifts into actionable presales strategies for the region.
  • Identify whitespace opportunities where Insight can develop new solution offerings or expand existing capabilities to meet emerging client needs in the Southeast market.
  • Contribute to Insight's broader infrastructure solutions roadmap by synthesizing field-level intelligence on client demand patterns, competitive positioning, and technology adoption trends.
  • Champion innovation within the team, encouraging proof-of-concept development, lab environments, and collaborative initiatives that can be scaled regionally and nationally.

What You'll Need to Join Insight

Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field required; Master's degree or MBA preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in technology solutions, IT architecture, or presales engineering, with significant exposure to enterprise-scale environments.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience, including building and managing technical presales or solutions architecture teams.
  • Proven track record of supporting complex, multi-million-dollar services and solutions engagements in a consultative selling environment.
  • Deep technical expertise across two or more of the following domains:

Infrastructure Solution Domains

  • Cloud, Compute & Storage (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP, hybrid cloud, HCI, enterprise storage)
  • Security (e.g., zero trust, SIEM/SOAR, identity & access management, endpoint protection)
  • Managed Services (e.g., NOC/SOC operations, ITSM, managed detection & response)
  • AI & Automation (e.g., AIOps, infrastructure automation, intelligent operations, ML/AI platforms)
  • Networking, IoT & Edge (e.g., SD-WAN, network modernization, edge computing, IoT platforms)

Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional ability to translate complex technical architectures into business value narratives for senior IT stakeholders and decision-makers.
  • Strong understanding of outcome-based and services-led selling motions, with the ability to coach technical teams on commercial awareness.
  • Experience developing or leveraging repeatable solution frameworks, reference architectures, and presales playbooks.
  • Strong communication skills, including room presence and peer leadership — comfortable presenting to client technical teams and large audiences.
  • Wide technology background with emphasis on data center technologies (e.g., network, compute, storage, virtualization).
  • Proven ability to build strong cross-functional relationships with sales, delivery, partner, and marketing organizations.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to balance long-term team development with near-term execution and pipeline demands.
  • Experience managing resource allocation and capacity planning for a regional presales team.
  • Relevant industry certifications are a plus (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, CISSP, CCIE, TOGAF, ITIL).

We're legendary for taking care of you, your family, and helping you engage with your local community. We want you to enjoy a full, meaningful life and own your career at Insight. Some of our benefits include:
