raw.excerpt: Construyendo sobre nuestro pasado.  Listos para el futuro Worley es una firma global de servicios profesionales compuesta por expertos en energía, productos químicos y recursos.
raw.description:
Construyendo sobre nuestro pasado. Listos para el futuro

Worley es una firma global de servicios profesionales compuesta por expertos en energía, productos químicos y recursos. Nos asociamos con clientes para entregar proyectos y crear valor durante la vida útil de sus activos. Estamos uniendo dos mundos, avanzando hacia fuentes de energía más sostenibles y al mismo tiempo ayudamos a proporcionar la energía, los productos químicos y los recursos que se necesitan ahora.

Objetivo del cargo:

Trabajar de forma autónoma a un nivel avanzado en tareas de dibujo y modelamiento, completando una amplia variedad de tareas mediante la aplicación de técnicas y prácticas de dibujo y modelamiento. Debe tener un conocimiento sustancial de buenas prácticas estándar de la industria relevantes para el desarrollo y control de entregables de dibujo y modelamiento. Puede proporcionar supervisión en relación con actividades de dibujo y modelamiento para un proyecto grande, o uno o más proyectos más pequeños.

Responsabilidades:

·Realizar ingenierías conceptuales, básicas y detalladas de proyectos de la industria Oil & Gas, Minería, Infraestructura, entre otros.

·Por lo general, tener experiencia relevante en la disciplina y un conocimiento y comprensión competente de las regulaciones, códigos, estándares de diseño y fabricación, y prácticas estándar de la industria. Adicionalmente debe tener conocimientos sólidos en la estimación de los costos de un proyecto y la redacción de contenidos de propuestas.

·Tomar decisiones responsables para la definición del curso de entregables de ingeniería, dibujo y modelamiento.

·Realizar sus funciones con base en una interacción y orientación técnica autoiniciada con el supervisor (gerente de la disciplina), para posteriormente influenciar sobre los objetivos y deberes de su equipo.

·Desarrollar, asignar y coordinar ofertas técnicas, documentos, planimetrías y levantamientos en campo.

·Elaborar las memorias de cálculo y documentos de soporte para los diseños.

·Iniciar, gestionar y, si es necesario, supervisar los requerimientos del proyecto de ingeniería eléctrica.

·Liderar equipos y brindar mentoría a ingenieros junior y dibujantes (proporcionar guía técnica, información de referencia, asignación de tareas, revisión y aprobación de entregables, entre otros).

·Participar en reuniones relevantes, preparar informes de progreso y seguir los procedimientos de verificación requeridos.

·Garantizar que el alcance del proyecto sea claro y que los cambios cumplan con los procesos de gestión de cambios del proyecto.

·Realizar visitas a campo según requerimientos del proyecto.

·Participar en el desarrollo, revisión y licitación de contratos técnicos.

¿Qué traerás?

  • Entre 5 y 20 años de experiencia como Ingeniero Eléctrico en los sectores de Oil & Gas y/o Refinería.
  • Tener experiencia en revisión y diseño de diagramas unifilares, diagramas de control, bases de diseño, listados de cargas y equipos eléctricos, dimensionamientos de equipos, especificaciones, hojas de datos y requisiciones.
  • Tener conocimientos en diseño de sistemas eléctricos de Alta, media y baja tensión.
  • Habilidad para el desarrollo de estudios eléctricos empleando programas como NEPLAN y ETAP.
  • Soporte en compra de equipos y evaluación técnica de ofertas.
  • Contar con conocimiento de normas técnicas como IEC, IEEE/ANSI.
  • Manejo de SPEL y revisión de modelos en Smart Plan 3D.
  • Tener manejo de programas como Dialux, AutoCAD, Navis Works

En caso de que necesites algún ajuste de accesibilidadpor favor no dejes de aclararlo en tu postulación

Avanzando juntos

Estamos comprometidos a construir un lugar de trabajo diverso, inclusivo y respetuoso donde todos sientan que pertenecen, puedan hablar y ser escuchados. Brindamos igualdad de oportunidades de empleo a todos los solicitantes y empleados calificados sin importar edad, raza, credo, color, religión, sexo, origen nacional, ascendencia, estado de discapacidad, estado de veterano, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género, información genética, estado civil. estatus, estatus de ciudadanía o cualquier otra base protegida por la ley.

Queremos que nuestra gente esté llena de energía y poder para impulsar un impacto sostenible. Por eso, nos centramos en una cultura inspirada en valores que genere brillantez a través de la pertenencia, la conexión y la innovación.

Estamos construyendo un lugar de trabajo diverso, inclusivo y respetuoso. Crear un espacio donde todos sientan que pertenecen, puedan ser ellos mismos y ser escuchados.

raw.title: Marketing Advisor - Motion Designer & Content Creator
raw.excerpt: Building on our past.  Ready for the futureWorley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts.
raw.description:
Building on our past. Ready for the future

Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.

About the role

It's not always easy to find the right words and images for the work Worley does with our customers. But this is what our team is all about. We find the words. We tell the story. We do this alongside the Global Brand & Marketing Team, surrounded by industry experts and people who care what happens next. We're looking for a Motion Designer and Content Creator to join our Creative team in the production of content that helps bring our brand, campaigns, people stories and customer stories to life. In this role, you will develop high-quality motion graphics, video, static design assets and written content. You will work with marketers, stakeholders and other writers and designers to create content that is on brand, fit for channel and useful to our audience.

Principal Responsibilities:

Create motion graphics, video, static design assets and short-form written content.

• Turn briefs and complex subject matter into engaging stories.

• Support creative concepts, storyboards, scripts and content narratives.

• Design and edit video content from brief to delivery.

• Ensure all work aligns with Worley brand standards and accessibility requirements.

• Leverage emerging tools and AI-assisted workflows while collaborating with the creative team.

What you’ll do:

  • Create motion graphics, video, static design assets and short-form written content for campaigns, customer engagement, thought leadership, employer brand and corporate brand initiatives.

  • Turn briefs, messages and complex subject matter into clear, engaging visual and written stories that work for the channel and audience.

  • Support the development of creative concepts, storyboards, scripts, treatments and content narratives from early idea through to final output.

  • Design and edit video content from brief to delivery, including motion design, editing, audio, captions, versioning and format adaptation.

  • Make sure every piece of creative work reflects Worley’s brand standards, tone of voice, accessibility needs and channel requirements

  • Use emerging tools, production methods and AI-assisted workflows to improve speed, scalability and quality, while managing priorities and collaborating with the wider creative team.

What you’ll have:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in motion design, video editing, content creation, graphic design or adjacent creative roles, ideally in an in-house brand, B2B or advertising agency environment.

  • Good conceptual, storytelling and writing ability, with the judgement to help turn complex technical or business content into clear visual and written narratives.

  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, especially After Effects, Premiere Pro, Illustrator and Photoshop; working knowledge of Audition, Media Encoder and Adobe Firefly preferred

  • Experience using AI image and video generation platforms such as Gemini, Veo or similar tools to support concept development, visual exploration, and production workflows, with sound judgement around quality, brand fit, copyright, ethical use and human oversight.

  • Capability in storyboarding, scripting, animatics, editing and motion design, including typography in motion, pacing and transitions, audio design and versioning for different formats and channels.

  • Strong writing and editing skills for short-form digital, video, campaign, social and presentation content.

  • Good design craft and attention to detail, with an eye for typography, composition, hierarchy, colour, brand consistency, tone of voice and motion behaviour.

  • Experience creating content for platform-native environments including social, web, presentations, paid media and events, with an understanding of aspect ratios, cut-downs, subtitles and accessibility considerations.

  • Comfort working with stakeholders, discussing creative rationale, responding to feedback and helping solve briefs effectively.

  • Good production discipline, including file organisation, asset management, version control and the ability to manage multiple projects while maintaining quality and deadlines.

  • Strong written English skills, with the ability to adapt content for clear, accessible communication across global audiences.

  • Strong organizational and time management skills

  • Some understanding/familiarity with content best practices for LinkedIn.

  • A collaborative team member who is also comfortable working independently

  • Demonstrated experience or a willingness to work remotely as part of a global team.

Required qualifications:

  • Degree, diploma or equivalent experience in motion design, animation, graphic design, film, visual communication, content creation, writing or a related creative disciplina

  • A strong portfolio or showreel demonstrating motion graphics, video editing, design and content work across multiple formats and channels, including examples that show storytelling, writing input, brand application and final execution.

If you need any accessibility adjustments, please make sure to mention it in your application.

Moving forward together

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.

We’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.

Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change

Ready to engineer what’s next? Apply today.

Debe tener un conocimiento sustancial de buenas prácticas estándar de la industria relevantes para el desarrollo y control de entregables de dibujo y modelamiento. Puede proporcionar supervisión en relación con actividades de dibujo y modelamiento para un proyecto grande, o uno o más proyectos más pequeños.

Principales Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar labores de dibujo y modelamiento del área eléctrica para proyectos de la industria Oil & Gas, Minería, Infraestructura, entre otros.
  • Tomar decisiones responsables para el curso de entregables de dibujo y modelamiento. Las decisiones difíciles, complejas o inusuales generalmente se remiten a miembros de disciplina más experimentados como ingenieros, sobre quienes recae toda la responsabilidad del diseño.
  • Recibir asignaciones relacionadas con proyectos con objetivos y prioridades específicas. Puede ser supervisor de actividades o también tener supervisión para determinación de precisión, integridad y cumplimiento de los objetivos. Puede recibir capacitación supervisada/autodidacta en prácticas/aplicaciones de trabajo disciplinario más avanzadas.
  • Trabajar en equipo con grupos de hasta 6 subordinados directos que consisten en diseñadores menos experimentados dentro de la misma disciplina.
  • Mantener una comunicación constante y efectiva con el equipo de trabajo, para informar y persuadir sobre asuntos complejos y problemas a través de la preparación y entrega de presentaciones e informes, así como la colaboración con las partes interesadas y la gerencia de la disciplina.
  • Trabajar de manera competente y eficiente en herramientas de diseño especializado, análisis y modelado, y métodos centrados en datos interdisciplinarios.
  • Trabajar en un equipo con visibilidad para las partes interesadas en altos niveles, ser capaz de trabajar y vincularse con múltiples equipos y partes interesadas, ser capaz de priorizar las cargas de trabajo y ayudar a otros miembros del equipo a lograr sus objetivos.

¿Qué traerás?

  • Mínimo 5 años de experiencia como dibujante o proyectista eléctrico en los sectores de Oil & Gas y/o Refinería.
  • Tener conocimientos en diseño de sistemas eléctricos de Alta, media y baja tensión.
  • Contar con conocimiento de normas técnicas como IEC, IEEE/ANSI.
  • Experiencia en desarrollo de diagramas unifilares, diagramas de control y protección, así como planimetrías de apantallamiento, rutas, tierras, iluminación y áreas clasificadas.
  • Manejo de modelamiento 3D y gestión de interferencias.
  • Tener manejo de Software como: AutoCAD 2D y 3D, Smart Plan y Navis Works.

En caso de que necesites algún ajuste de accesibilidadpor favor no dejes de aclararlo en tu postulación

Avanzando juntos

Estamos comprometidos a construir un lugar de trabajo diverso, inclusivo y respetuoso donde todos sientan que pertenecen, puedan hablar y ser escuchados. Brindamos igualdad de oportunidades de empleo a todos los solicitantes y empleados calificados sin importar edad, raza, credo, color, religión, sexo, origen nacional, ascendencia, estado de discapacidad, estado de veterano, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género, información genética, estado civil. estatus, estatus de ciudadanía o cualquier otra base protegida por la ley.

Queremos que nuestra gente esté llena de energía y poder para impulsar un impacto sostenible. Por eso, nos centramos en una cultura inspirada en valores que genere brillantez a través de la pertenencia, la conexión y la innovación.

Estamos construyendo un lugar de trabajo diverso, inclusivo y respetuoso. Crear un espacio donde todos sientan que pertenecen, puedan ser ellos mismos y ser escuchados.

Y no estamos hablando sólo de eso; lo estamos haciendo. Estamos recapacitando a nuestra gente, aprovechando habilidades transferibles y apoyando la transición de nuestra fuerza laboral para convertirse en expertos en la infraestructura y tecnología de energía baja en carbono de hoy.

raw.description:
Real Estate Sales Agent

The voice that turns a quiet client database into real conversations about buying or selling.

Sector

Real Estate — US-based.

Reports to

Real Estate Agent

Type

Full-time

Hours

Full overlap with Pacific Time required

Rate

$4–$6/hr USD - DOE

Location

Fully remote

Tools

Contact list (previously used Follow Up Boss and RealGeeks), email, SMS/text platform, Facebook, Instagram

Role Overview

This role reactivates our client's existing database of past clients, referrals, and leads through email, text, and social media outreach — generating renewed interest in buying or selling a home. The Real Estate Sales Executive does not close deals; they generate and qualify interest, then hand off warm conversations to the agents for closing.

Key Responsibilities

Database Outreach & Reactivation

  • Send emails and text messages to contacts in the client's database to reopen the conversation about buying or selling
  • Track outreach activity: who was contacted, who responded, and who needs follow-up
  • Personalize outreach based on each contact's history (past client, old lead, referral)

Social Media Outreach

  • Reach out to relevant contacts via Facebook and Instagram messages
  • Identify and engage people showing buying or selling signals on social platforms
  • Keep messaging warm and personal — this is relationship reactivation, not cold advertising

Lead Qualification & Handoff

  • Identify when a contact shows genuine interest in buying or selling
  • Log conversation context clearly so the agents can pick it up without missing anything
  • Hand off qualified conversations promptly so momentum isn't lost

Tracking & Reporting

  • Keep a simple, current record of outreach activity and responses
  • Flag which messages get replies and which contacts are warming up

Who Will Succeed

This role is steady, repetitive, and relationship-driven. The person who thrives here doesn't get discouraged by silence or 'no' — they stay warm, consistent, and genuinely curious about people.

  • You're comfortable with repetitive outreach and don't take non-responses personally
  • You write and message in a natural, warm tone — never scripted or salesy
  • You're organized — nothing you send or hear back goes untracked
  • You're comfortable on social media and know how to message people without feeling like a stranger
  • You use AI tools to draft and personalize outreach faster, without losing the human touch
  • You know the difference between generating interest and closing a deal — and you're energized by the first part

    Experience & Skills
  • Required: Some familiarity with real estate concepts (buying/selling process, what a lead or database contact looks like) — not necessarily an expert
  • Required: Some experience with outreach, ISA (inside sales), or lead generation work — cold or warm outreach experience counts
  • Required: Strong written English — emails, texts, and DMs represent the client directly; writing is assessed at screening
  • Required: AI expertise — genuinely skilled with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) for drafting, personalizing, and speeding up outreach; this is a real capability, not casual use, and will be assessed
  • Required: Full overlap with Pacific Time required — not partial coordination
  • Required: Comfortable managing outreach across multiple channels (email, SMS, Facebook, Instagram) at once

    -Preferred:     Prior experience with a real estate CRM or database system

MTSI is currently seeking to hire a Financial System Analyst to join our Finance team.
This role is 100% remote.

Overview

We are seeking an accomplished technology leader with deep expertise in Deltek Costpoint, enterprise system integrations (including SAP/HR, ADP and Workday Adaptive), and advanced SQL/PL-SQL development. This senior-level role is responsible for defining technical architecture, integration strategy, and data governance framework supporting mission-critical financial, HR, and business operational processes. The Financial System Analyst will drive long-term modernization initiatives, ensure data integrity across the enterprise ecosystem, and provide strategic guidance to technical teams and business stakeholders. The ideal candidate excels at translating business requirements into efficient, scalable technical solutions while maintaining system stability, data accuracy, and process automation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the architectural design, roadmap planning, and governance for Costpoint and its integrations with enterprise systems.
  • Serve as the highest-level technical authority for Costpoint configurations, data models, security design, workflows, and custom solutions.
  • Design, build, and maintain integrations between Costpoint and internal/external systems (HRIS, financial systems, procurement tools, data warehouses, etc.). Architect scalable, secure integration frameworks using APIs, middleware, ETL pipelines, and event-driven processes.
  • Develop SQL and PL/SQL scripts to support reporting, data validation, performance tuning, and system automation.
  • Serve as the primary liaison with Deltek Support to engineer resolutions, manage escalations, and investigate complex issues.
  • Troubleshoot integration failures, data discrepancies, and system performance challenges, ensuring effective and timely resolution.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Finance, Payroll, HR, IT, Procurement, Program Control) to gather requirements and deliver scalable, reliable technical solutions aligned with strategic business objectives.
  • Support system upgrades, patches, enhancements, and related data interface updates.
  • Maintain strong data integrity across systems through robust testing, documentation, quality controls, and monitoring practices.
  • Provide technical leadership and best practices for Costpoint integrations, database optimization, system architecture, and change management processes.

Qualifications

Required Experience:

Bachelors degree with 10 years related experience.

Required Clearance:

US Citizenship required.

Required Skills:

  • Extensive hands-on experience with Deltek Costpoint, including configuration, data structures, workflows, integrations, and reporting.
  • Expert-level SQL and PL/SQL skills, including query optimization, performance tuning, complex troubleshooting, and advanced reporting techniques.
  • Strong experience architecting integrations using APIs, web services, middleware platforms, or cloud-based integration technologies.
  • Working knowledge of database platforms such as Oracle and SQL Server.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise finance, and procurement workflows in Costpoint
  • Proven ability to design and lead implementations, upgrades, and modernization initiatives.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Excellent communication skills, capable of presenting technical strategies to technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Skills

• Experience with Deltek Time & Expense, Costpoint BI tools, Enterprise reporting/analytics platforms, ADP, SAP/HR, Workday Adaptive, Excel, ODBC connections.
• Familiarity with HR systems, financial forecasting tools, data management platforms, and evolving enterprise architecture patterns.
• Background in government contracting or other highly regulated industries.
• Experience mentoring analysts, developers, and integration engineers.

At NVIDIA, we address some of the world’s most exciting challenges with our unique approach to accelerated computing. As a Senior Quantum Algorithm Researcher you will help grow the adoption of our products and collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Research teams to drive innovation at the intersection of quantum computing applications and AI. Your work will contribute to NVIDIA quantum product in key areas such as AI methods for quantum algorithm discovery, advanced quantum simulations, and digital twins.

NVIDIA’s Quantum group is a small, high-impact team visible both internally within NVIDIA and externally across the global quantum community. We’re looking for passionate quantum algorithm researchers who want to help define the future of the field. Do you have deep technical expertise in quantum algorithms and applications, and a drive to push the boundaries of technology? If yes, we’d love to hear from you!

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Establish and lead technical collaborations with supercomputing centers (SCCs) on hybrid quantum-classical application development across multiple industry verticals.

  • Guide all aspects of and drive the execution of technical results for projects in collaboration with our strategic partnerships, including SCCs, leading QPU builders, and needle-moving researchers, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and customer success.

  • Contribute to NVIDIA’s revenue stream through strategic technical engagement and the development of innovative solutions that support customer adoption and long-term partnerships.

  • Deep insider knowledge of, and strong connections within, the Singapore quantum ecosystem.

  • Demonstrated leadership in technical collaborations with industry partners. Excellent programming skills in Python, C++, and a parallel programming model (e.g., CUDA).

  • World-class communication and interpersonal skills with a proven ability to articulate a value proposition to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • A track record of research excellence demonstrated in publications and presentations at leading conferences.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:

  • Recognized thought-leadership in the cross section of quantum applied research and high-performance computing.

  • Experience with the NVIDIA Quantum platform (cuQuantum and CUDA-Q)!

NVIDIA is searching for an outstanding research scientist to build humanoid robot foundation models and systems in the Generalist Embodied Agent Research (GEAR) group. Everything that moves will eventually be autonomous. Multimodal Foundation Models

  • Familiarity with physics simulation frameworks such as MuJoCo and Isaac Sim;

  • Robot hardware design and hands-on building experience.

raw.excerpt: NVIDIA is the world leader in accelerated computing.
raw.description:
NVIDIA is the world leader in accelerated computing. Our innovations in GPU technology, AI, and data center solutions are transforming industries worldwide. Join our engineering group passionate about local product development in Israel to play a meaningful role in bringing powerful hardware products from building to mass production.

The Local Product Engineering (LPE) group bridges the gap between hardware build, NPI phase and high-volume manufacturing. We work closely with contract manufacturers (CMs) globally to ensure mechanical readiness, production quality, and manufacturing excellence across NVIDIA’s networking product portfolio. We are looking for a Mechanical Product Engineer to own the mechanical aspects of production test fixtures, jigs, and enclosures. This role leads upkeep and adjustment oversight across CM sites. It supports NPI mechanical readiness and brings a strong manufacturing perspective into hardware development reviews.

What you'll be doing:

  • Fixture & Jig Support — Maintenance, and continuous improvement of production testing setups, jigs, mechanical enclosures, and assembly tooling. Ensure compatibility, standardization, and seamless integration of jigs across multiple product lines and CM sites.

  • Maintenance & Calibration Governance — Own and enforce maintenance/calibration processes across all products and contract manufacturing locations. Author process documentation. Lead quarterly maintenance audits at CM facilities. Drive calibration frequency reduction initiatives.

  • Equipment Limit Management — Perform data-driven analysis of test equipment limits (mating cycles, cable wear). Recommend and approve limit extensions based on engineering data and risk assessment.

  • NPI Mechanical Support — Escort new products through mechanical readiness achievements — from prototype through V&V station approval to large-scale manufacturing. Support station duplication and mechanical training for CM technicians.

  • Cross-Site CM Coordination — Provide hands-on technical support to global CMs (Flex Israel, Jabil India, Foxconn Vietnam). Resolve mechanical gaps, fixture issues, and production blockers in real-time.

  • Quality Audits & Compliance — Conduct structured quality audits at manufacturing sites focused on mechanical processes, fixture condition, and maintenance compliance. Drive corrective actions.

  • Participate in KO, PDR, CDR sessions passionate about hardware build, contributing insights from production and manufacturing perspectives. Identify potential mechanical issues early in the design cycle.

  • ECO Management — Review and process Engineering Change Orders related to fixtures, mechanical assemblies, and production tooling. Ensure documentation and version control via Agile/PDP.

What we need to see:

  • B.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent

  • 3+ years of experience working as a mechanical engineer in a production/manufacturing environment

  • Hands-on experience with fixture and jig design for electronics manufacturing or test

  • Strong ability to read, interpret, and review mechanical drawings and assembly drawings.

  • Proficiency in 3D CAD tools (Creo Parametric / SolidWorks / similar)

  • Knowledge of maintenance and calibration processes in high-volume manufacturing

  • Experience working alongside contract manufacturers or EMS providers

  • Strong analytical skills — data-driven limit analysis and evaluation of potential hazards

  • Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal)

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience in the semiconductor or data center hardware industry

  • Familiarity with Agile PLM / PDP systems for ECO and BOM management

  • Background in V&V (Validation & Verification) environments

  • Experience conducting supplier/manufacturing audits

  • Knowledge of thermal management and thermal pad/TIM applications

raw.title: Senior AI Researcher - World Foundation Models
raw.excerpt: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years.
raw.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

NVIDIA is building the next generation of AI systems that can perceive, reason about, and generate dynamic worlds. Our team advances world foundation models to enable high-fidelity, temporally stable video and world generation for Physical AI, simulation, and interactive experiences. This role operates at the applied-research boundary: developing and validating model improvements, then hardening them into production-grade checkpoints and recipes that teams can reliably build on. The technical focus is on human appearance, motion and action understanding. Progress is measured through disciplined experimentation, robust diagnostics, and repeatable side-by-side evaluation. Work is delivered in close partnership with data, platform, and product engineering to ensure improvements translate into real performance and quality.

What you'll be doing:

  • Research, implement, and validate model architecture and algorithm changes that improve video generation fidelity, with emphasis on human-centric quality.

  • Explore and prototype improvements across spatial multimodal modeling, modality alignment, flow-based or diffusion-based video generation, and neural rendering-inspired representations to improve controllability and long-horizon consistency.

  • Improve training and inference efficiency through architectural and post-training techniques (compute/memory optimizations, distillation, pruning, and compression).

  • Define model training objectives that improve sim-to-real and real-to-sim generalization, especially for human motion, contact, and interaction dynamics across real-world and synthetic/simulation data.

  • Develop detailed, domain-specific benchmarks for evaluating world foundation models, especially generation and understanding world models that reason about video, simulation, and physical environments.

  • Translate research results into robust implementations like training code, production-grade checkpoints, model integrations, and demos that clearly showcase capability gains across teams.

What we need to see:

  • PhD in Computer Science, Graphics, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field (or equivalent experience).

  • 8+ years of applied research and/or industry experience in vision, graphics, or adjacent ML domains or similar area.

  • 3+ years of direct experience designing, training, and evaluating generative models for image/video/audio, with strong fundamentals in modern deep learning.

  • Hands-on experience improving generative models with a focus on perceptual quality and temporal stability, especially for generating humans.

  • Advanced proficiency in Python, PyTorch, C++, and CUDA with strong research-engineering practices (reproducibility, testing, profiling, experiment tracking).

  • Experience training and debugging large models in multi-GPU and/or multi-node environments and distributed training workflows

  • Practical knowledge of inference/runtime bottlenecks and optimization techniques.

  • Strong “eye for quality” and interest in diagnosing visual artifacts (sharpness, texture detail, temporal stability, etc.) using perceptual metrics, human preference signals, or learned evaluators.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Proven track record in related research, including publications in top conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, CVPR, ICLR), with clear evidence of impact on model quality or robustness.

  • Experience using agentic workflows, and AI coding companions, to accelerate research and production development, including code generation, debugging, test creation, experiment automation, benchmark development, documentation, and large-codebase navigation.

Join us to help build the next generation of world models! Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

raw.title: Senior GPU Raytracing Engineer
raw.excerpt: We are seeking a self‑motivated senior engineer for the Aerial Omniverse Digital Twin team.
raw.description:
We are seeking a self‑motivated senior engineer for the Aerial Omniverse Digital Twin team. This hire will lead the design and implementation of a real‑time, GPU‑accelerated propagation engine that predicts how radio signals travel through realistic 3‑D environments — producing both per‑link channel characterisations and radio maps at the speed required by production RAN stacks! This position offers the opportunity to work on foundational technology for 5G and 6G network simulation, using NVIDIA's world‑class GPU and ray‑tracing platforms.

What you'll be doing:

As a member of NVIDIA's Aerial team, you will architect and implement a GPU ray‑tracing engine that operates at two time scales. At the planning scale, the engine produces volumetric radio maps — coverage, SINR, and best‑server maps at multiple resolutions, composable across cells, frequencies, and beam configurations — that network operators use to design and optimise deployments. At the real‑time scale, the same engine delivers per‑link multipath channel updates at the millisecond cadence that a production RAN stack requires, using adaptive algorithms that exploit temporal coherence to avoid recomputing what hasn't changed. Laying the foundations for real‑time ray tracing on GPU hardware — algorithms, data structures, and multi‑GPU scaling strategies that make sub‑millisecond propagation updates feasible — is the defining technical challenge of this role.

What we need to see:

  • PhD in computer graphics, high‑performance computing, computational electromagnetics, or a closely related field (or equivalent experience).

  • 8+ years of relevant experience.

  • Hands‑on proficiency with CUDA and at least one GPU ray‑tracing framework (OptiX, Vulkan RT, Embree), with a track record of writing production‑quality GPU code.

  • Proficiency in GPU‑friendly spatial data structures (BVH, space‑filling curves, hash maps) and the ability to reason about memory hierarchy, occupancy, and compute‑vs‑bandwidth trade‑offs at the kernel level.

  • Working knowledge of electromagnetic wave propagation phenomena (reflection, transmission, diffraction, scattering) sufficient to implement and validate a propagation engine.

  • Impactful publications in GPU ray tracing, real‑time rendering, or deterministic propagation modelling.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience with real‑time or near‑real‑time ray‑tracing engines shipping in production systems.

  • Prior work on multi‑GPU partitioning for ray‑tracing or large‑scale simulation workloads.

  • Familiarity with 3GPP channel models and wireless network planning tools.

  • Knowledge of geospatial coordinate systems and tiling schemes.

Great underwriters know that the best decisions come from blending analytical thinking with real market instincts. If you thrive on the challenge of growing a book of business, building influential broker relationships, and making your mark in a specialty vertical, this is your opportunity.

As a Senior Underwriter in Liberty Mutual's Healthcare & Life Sciences Practice Group — a specialized unit within Major Accounts — you will underwrite Workers' Compensation, Commercial Auto, and General Liability (non-products) across all program structures with a primary emphasis on loss-sensitive accounts. You will partner with Loss Control, Industry Consulting, and Claims to deepen your expertise in the healthcare and life sciences sectors while driving profitable growth.

This is a range posting for a Senior or Executive-level Underwriter, depending upon experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Book of Business Development: Develop, grow, and maintain a profitable, diversified book of primary casualty business through sound underwriting decisions, strong agent/broker relationships, and effective use of underwriting tools and resources. Mentor less experienced underwriters in technical and professional skills.
  • Risk Selection: evaluates opportunities by qualifying accounts; identifying, selecting and assessing risks; determining the premium, policy terms and conditions; obtaining approvals; creating/presenting the proposal to the agent/broker and successfully negotiating deals.
  • Agent/Broker Relationships: Market to an assigned territory targeting healthcare and life science accounts. Build and maintain strong relationships with brokers through responsive service, site visits, and in-person meetings. Partner across markets deliver holistic account solutions.
  • Portfolio Management: Analyze and manage a complex book of business, identifying opportunities for growth, profit improvement, and diversification. Execute targeted marketing plans and use pricing models to ensure portfolio profitability.
  • Service Value Proposition: Clearly articulate the specialized services Liberty Mutual offers healthcare insureds relative to competitors..
  • Documenting the Deal: Maintain thorough file documentation that reflects sound decision-making through account reviews, sign-offs, and referrals in compliance with state regulations and underwriting guidelines.
  • Leadership: Mentor and coach underwriters on technical and professional skills. Share subject matter expertise and provide regular insights to the broader underwriting team.
  • Continuous Improvement: Actively engage in daily huddles, problem-solving activities, and continuous improvement initiatives to support team performance and operational excellence.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Business or equivalent typically required. 3 to 7 years of commercial lines underwriting experience preferred, with a proven track record of developing and underwriting profitable business.
  • CPCU or professional insurance designation preferred.
  • Analytical ability across all phases of the underwriting process with proficiency in qualitative and quantitative tools and techniques. Must demonstrate knowledge of underwriting, pricing, risk selection, and territory management.

Somos o DOMO

O hub de inovação e tecnologia de um dos maiores e mais consolidados bancos do Brasil: o Banco Mercantil. Criado para atuar como um núcleo de desenvolvimento de soluções conectadas com o novo e com as demandas do futuro.

Somos intensos na busca por soluções e acreditamos que, para sermos inovadores, precisamos trabalhar em uma esfera profunda de ideias sem restrições.

Aqui, boas ideias sempre têm espaço. Acreditamos na força da diversidade e no poder da inclusão para transformar realidades. Por isso, nossas oportunidades são estendidas a pessoas com deficiência, pessoas pretas e indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+, pessoas com mais de 50 anos, mulheres cadastradas em programas assistenciais de enfrentamento à violência doméstica, entre outros grupos minorizados. Seguimos firmes na construção de um ambiente justo, representativo e com oportunidades reais para todas e todos. Vem com a gente!

Se você se identificou, venha fazer parte.

#VEMSERDOMO

Confira oBanco de Talentosabaixo para que possa fazer parte das futuras oportunidades:

Seus principais desafios serão:

  • Atuar no atendimento às demandas do Catálogo de Serviços da área de Arquitetura de TI;
  • Consultorias técnicas para apoio às áreas de negócio e equipes de tecnologia;
  • Elaboração de estimativas técnicas e orçamentárias para iniciativas e projetos;
  • Definição e desenho de soluções de arquitetura corporativa e de sistemas;
  • Concepção e sustentação de arquiteturas para projetos estratégicos;
  • Avaliação de conformidade arquitetural, aderência a padrões, políticas e boas práticas;
  • Apoio a iniciativas de inovação, transformação digital e evolução tecnológica.

Buscamos uma pessoa com:

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Computação ou áreas afins;
  • Atuação prévia como Arquiteto(a) de Soluções, com conhecimentos em Arquitetura de Aplicações, Integrações, Dados, Infraestrutura, Segurança e Tecnologias Corporativas;
  • Capacidade de atuação em ambiente dinâmico e multidisciplinar;
  • Visão sistêmica e foco em geração de valor para o negócio;
  • Experiência com soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta disponibilidade.

Vai se destacar se apresentar:

  • Pós graduação correlata;
  • Experiência prévia em bancos ou instituições financeiras;
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas de microsserviços, padrões de governança de dados, enterprise integration patterns, modelos C4, Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) , Requests for Comments (RFCs), High Level Archictectures (HLA), Modelagem de ameaças cibernéticas (Threat Modeling).

raw.description:
TriNet is a leading provider of comprehensive human resources solutions for small to midsize businesses (SMBs). We enhance business productivity by enabling our clients to outsource their HR function to one strategic partner and allowing them to focus on operating and growing their core businesses. Our full-service HR solutions include features such as payroll processing, human capital consulting, employment law compliance and employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans and workers’ compensation insurance.

TriNet has a nationwide presence and an experienced executive team. Our stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol TNET. If you’re passionate about innovation and making an impact on the large SMB market, come join us as we power our clients’ business success with extraordinary HR.

Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that many potential applicants discourage themselves from applying to jobs unless they meet every single requirement. TriNet always strives to hire the most qualified candidate for a particular role, ensuring we deliver outstanding results for our small and medium-size customers. So if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every single qualification in the job description, nobody’s perfect – and we encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

Job Summary

As a Sales Consultant with TriNet you’ll help power business success with extraordinary HR by pursuing new prospects, sharing and quantifying our value proposition, and selling TriNet’s comprehensive solution which includes access to benefits, payroll, and HR services to companies with 5-99 employees within your designated territory. You’ll prospect and build your own book of business, own your opportunities and execute your sales process an organized calendar of activities. In an effort of exceeding quota, you’ll build pipeline, conduct sales meetings with prospective clients, write proposals, gain approvals, and present those proposals to prospective clients, including C-level executives, business owners and other decision makers in midsize businesses.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities

  • Plan: Develop an annual plan to hit targets in defined territory, typically covering multiple states and/or regions and a diverse portfolio of industries, all centered around larger businesses with 5-99 employees.
  • Prospect: Consistently work on building a balanced pipeline of target prospects through traditional means of prospecting (cold calling, email, phone, LinkedIn) as well as building and leveraging a diverse group of ecosystem partners to provide referrals and business development opportunities.
  • Qualifying opportunities: Strong understanding of target market and decision-making personas will help to qualify or disqualify quickly.
  • Value & Consultative Selling: Establish a trusted advisor relationship, both inside of TriNet and within the prospect’s decision-making system, to effectively gain successful business and long-term client relationships.
  • Sales Process: Utilize a sophisticated and multi-step selling process with defined criteria, executive sponsorship and internal business processes. Balance multiple complex opportunities in parallel through the stages of typical 3-6-month sales process.
  • Sales tools and systems: Utilize Sales systems including Salesforce.com, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Zoominfo and quoting tools to efficiently and effectively manage daily activities.
  • Achieve quota target by meeting sales activity metrics.
  • Complete all administrative tasks and duties in a timely manner.
  • Demonstrate TriNet’s core values daily.

· Performs other duties as assigned

  • Complies with all policies and standards

Education and Experience Qualifications

  • Typically 8+ Years B2B Complex sales cycle

· Proven PEO Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience

Skills and Abilities

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate with colleagues at all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to build your own book of business from prospecting, sourcing, establishing and maximizing partner and referral networks.
  • Ability to build strong ecosystem partnerships and business referral relationships to share the value and mission of TriNet.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and sales opportunities at different stages.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, interpersonal skills and presentation skills.
  • A proven dedication to high professional ethical standards and a diverse workplace.
  • Ability to adapt to a fast paced continually evolving business and work environment while managing balancing priorities.
  • Experience with technology and common software and web applications, including MS Office and Salesforce.com.

· Detail oriented.

Travel Requirements

  • Ability and willingness to travel to prospective clients’ sites within your assigned territory.

Work Environment

  • Work in clean, pleasant, and comfortable home or office setting. The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable persons with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Position may be considered remote and require reliable and consistent internet service.

The salary range for this role is $85,000.00 to $106,700.00. The candidate’s final salary offer will be based on the candidate’s skills, education, work location and experience.

Candidates hired into roles in the sales organization are also eligible for commissions consistent with TriNet’s commission plan.

Additionally, subject to applicable eligibility requirements, TriNet offers permanent full-time employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, and vision plans, life and disability insurance, a 401(K) savings plan, an employee stock purchase plan, eleven (11) Company observed holidays, PTO and a comprehensive leave program. raw.excerpt: DescriptionJob Summary:Reviews new and existing small to mid contract risks submitted by assigned field offices to confirm compliance with Liberty Mutual Surety's underwriting strategies, guidelines and marketing objectives.
raw.description:
Description

Job Summary:

Reviews new and existing small to mid contract risks submitted by assigned field offices to confirm compliance with Liberty Mutual Surety's underwriting strategies, guidelines and marketing objectives. Utilizes objective perspective to identify omissions in underwriting detail, if any, confirm attributes and/or weaknesses of case and ratifies parameters of credit recommended for specific risks, with primary objective of achieving profitability for the department. Makes appropriate recommendations to senior Home Office staff on business above authority level or outside of standard underwriting guidelines. Manage audit function associated with the Surety Plus contract book of business using analytical tools.

Liberty Mutual Surety, a business unit of Liberty Mutual Insurance, is the world’s largest globally Surety, including in the United States. Conducting business worldwide through fronting relationships and Liberty-owned subsidiaries, we provide bonds in over 60 countries for construction firms, manufacturers and suppliers, and commercial enterprises on an account and transactional basis. We are committed to building mutually profitable relationships by providing smart business solutions, ease of doing business, and consistent, responsive service. Liberty Mutual Surety is dedicated to the communities we serve and highly values a diverse workforce in more than 18 countries.

Responsibilities:

  • Underwrites new and existing contract account submissions of a wide range in size and complexity utilizing underwriting authority granted by Chief Underwriting Officer.
  • Makes thorough evaluations and assessments of a contractor's financial, technical, organizational, and management capacities, as well as a subjective judgment of character, normally based upon data/insights provided by the field organization. In some cases, will meet with client to facilitate above assessments.
  • Monitors existing contract book of business from an underwriting standpoint using analytical tools.
  • Continuously evaluates the qualitative characteristics of the business (new and existing) in each of the field offices assigned to be his/her responsibility.
  • Assesses and identifies changes in all aspects of the business including, but not limited to, work program to financial strength criteria, nature of work performed (inherent risk), accuracy and timeliness of data flow, and exposure analyses.
  • Coordinates and surfaces issues to more senior Home Office staff and Bond Managers in the field offices on a regular and timely basis.

If the selected candidate lives within 50 miles of a GRS office, then the selected candidate should be prepared to come into the office two days/week. This policy is subject to change.

Ideally, the selected candidate can work a standard Pacific Time Zone schedule.

Qualifications
  • Degree in Business or equivalent typically required.
  • A minimum of 10 years of experience with progressive surety underwriting responsibility expected.
  • Prior field experience, including management experience, with an emphasis on underwriting large/complex obligations/programs desired.
  • Demonstrated ability to successfully manage underwriting oversight, preferably in multiple offices.
  • Must possess in-depth knowledge of surety industry, products, and operations, including the ability to analyze highly complex obligations/programs.
  • High level knowledge of Surety line(s) of business and can identify risk and takes reasonable effort to mitigate negative consequences.
  • Expert-level analytical abilities and decision-making skills to evaluate and judge underwriting risks within scope of responsibility.
  • Demonstrates an understanding of reinsurance, macro-economic issues and geo-political risk.
  • Results-oriented and proven track-record of taking individual initiative, exercising solid business judgment, and strategic thinking required.
  • Exceptional negotiating skills required.
  • Must have excellent written and verbal communication skills and strong executive presence with internal and external senior-level Executives required.
  • A proven coach and mentor with active participation in developing field and/or home office talent.

Description

Asst Director , Product Research, Liberty Mutual Mobility Solutions

Are you looking for an opportunity to join a nimble, high-performance team addressing a strategic and high-visibility opportunity for a Fortune 100 company? Liberty Mutual Mobility Solutions is working to develop solutions for the future of transportation, and we’re seeking a consultant to support product research and development for new mobility insurance products. You will be responsible for drafting and maintaining coverage language and forms, in addition to assessing product compliance. You will also prepare and collaborate on internal filings, as well as analyze competitor filings. Join us as we work with the firms that are changing the way people and goods move – including autonomous vehicles, ridehail, car sharing, subscription, micromobility, and more.

This role requires a highly adaptive and innovative approach to coverage design, including development of manuscript solutions for emerging mobility and autonomous vehicle risks where traditional insurance frameworks may not yet exist. The role will operate at the intersection of product, underwriting, claims, legal, and strategy to help shape scalable insurance solutions for evolving transportation models.

This role will help drive the development of mobility segment products and segment strategies to help us stay ahead of and capitalize on the disruptions we see and anticipate in the transportation space. A key to success in this role (and for the success of our team) will be the ability to adapt the traditional capabilities of commercial lines and personal lines insurance products to appropriately address the coverage needs of our mobility customers.

The role will play a key part in evaluating and designing coverage approaches for emerging risks associated with autonomous vehicles, teleoperation, platform liability, mixed fleet models, and evolving mobility ecosystems — often in environments where market standards and regulatory frameworks are still developing.

As part of the Mobility Solutions team, you will be involved with a top priority cross-business unit initiative aimed at positioning our company for success as transportation evolves. With a number of new mobility products already in market, this role will be responsible for executing on opportunities to improve and expand our portfolio.

Responsibilities:

• Product Development – You will be responsible for managing multiple Mobility product form and contract initiatives, including the preparation of filings. You'll analyze information from various resources and be able to make recommendations while working with others across LMMS. You will be innovating with other teams in order to design and develop coverage language for new products in a fast-paced environment.

• Coverage Innovation & Emerging Risk Design– Design and evolve manuscript coverage solutions for emerging mobility and AV exposures. Evaluate novel liability and operational models involving autonomous systems, teleoperation, platform liability, and mixed fleet structures. Partner across underwriting, claims, legal, actuarial, and strategy teams to develop commercially viable and scalable coverage approaches in areas where market standards are still emerging.

• Market/Product Research – You’ll be responsible for answering inquiries related to coverages, forms, manuscripts, and contracts. You will monitor bureau and state legislative activity, evaluating impacts to our existing Mobility products, as well as how competitors address coverage. Your insights on the current and competitor coverage landscape will be key to driving towards our profitability goals.

• Project Management - You will drive and coordinate cross-functional coverage initiatives, working closely with teammates in other functions (including partnerships, underwriting, pricing, and claims) and business units to build on our competitive advantage and enhance our positioning in the marketplace. Typical coverage work will be focused on pursuing new business opportunities, renewing key accounts, building critical capabilities, and building thought leadership in the marketplace.

Ideal candidate:

• Prior product experience with analyzing and drafting commercial insurance policy contracts, as well as preparing filings and responding to objections.

• Experience drafting manuscript coverage language and navigating complex or non-standard insurance structures strongly preferred.

• Project management experience working cross-functionally with multiple stakeholders.

• Prior experience pulling and reviewing competitor filings beneficial.

• Highly developed critical thinking, problem-solving, communication, and presentation skills.

• Prior experience in Claims, Underwriting, and/or Compliance in the insurance industry is helpful.

• Experience with Commercial Auto and/or General Liability products is preferable.

• Experience with emerging mobility, autonomous vehicle, transportation network company (TNC), specialty casualty, or other evolving risk environments is strongly preferred.

• Track record of framing decisions and recommending trade-offs.

• Demonstrated ability to build relationships and influence others (both with and without authority).

• Ability to manage and prioritize multiple initiatives.

Qualifications
  • Master's degree or equivalent in mathematics, economics, statistics, or other quantitative field
  • Minimum 6 years relevant work experience, typically 8 years
  • PhD or equivalent research beneficial
  • Expert skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and statistical software packages (eg, SAS, Emblem)
  • Must have exceptional planning, analytical, decision making, communication, and project management skills
  • Experience managing projects preferred

Description

At Liberty, our Personal Lines Auto Product team partners across the company to build and roll out auto insurance solutions that keep pace with what customers and agents need. We focus exclusively on auto, bringing deep expertise, data and analytics to deliver strong state-by-state results while modernizing how we price policies and the technology that supports them. Organized around four core areas—Delivery & Development, Underwriting Effectiveness, State Management, and Mobility Solutions—we work collaboratively to live our purpose: helping people embrace today and confidently pursue tomorrow.

The Product Delivery Monitoring Team is looking for a Consultant to help advance the next generation of Personal Lines Auto monitoring capabilities. This highly visible individual contributor role will partner across the organization to strengthen how we monitor Auto pricing programs, detect emerging issues, improve data accuracy, and scale sustainable monitoring practices across the broader Auto portfolio.

This role will focus heavily on building strategic monitoring capabilities that reduce programmatic risk, improve early issue detection, and create a scalable foundation for future growth. In addition, this individual will support core Auto Program Monitoring responsibilities, with a focus on program-level monitoring and analysis of recently launched pricing programs.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical and technically capable, comfortable working independently, able to navigate ambiguity, and effective at partnering cross-functionally with both technical and business audiences.

Responsibilities

• Drive the development and scaling of continuous monitoring and anomaly detection capabilities to reduce programmatic risk across the Auto portfolio.

• Improve data accuracy and early issue detection across rating programs, key business metrics, and Auto program results.

• Build scalable monitoring processes, tools, dashboards, and analytical frameworks that support future-state portfolio monitoring and program-level analysis.

• Reduce manual effort and response time through automation, improved reporting, and cross-functional coordination.

• Support program-level monitoring for Personal Lines Auto pricing programs by analyzing key metrics, identifying emerging trends, and assessing whether results are performing as expected.

• Query, manipulate, and analyze large datasets to investigate anomalies, identify root causes, and communicate actionable insights to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Partner with teams across USDS, the Data Office, IT, Risk Analytics, Underwriting, State Management, and other business areas to identify issues, coordinate solutions, and improve monitoring effectiveness.

• Provide timely updates and recommendations to stakeholders on monitoring results, data quality, program performance, and emerging risks.

Ideal candidate will have :

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to identify patterns, investigate root causes, and develop practical recommendations.

• Proficient in SQL, Power BI, Excel, PowerPoint, and Snowflake. Experience with Python and GitHub preferred.

• Experience building dashboards, reporting tools, analytical frameworks, and repeatable processes.

• Ability to communicate complex analytical findings clearly and effectively to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Strong planning, organizational, analytical, decision-making, and communication skills

• Prior experience in Personal Lines, auto insurance, pricing, product, or broader insurance analytics.

• Experience with anomaly detection, continuous monitoring, data quality monitoring, automation, or early issue detection.

• Experience partnering with data, technology, underwriting, risk analytics, state management, or product teams.

• Familiarity with insurance rating programs, pricing implementations, or post-launch program evaluation.

Description

As a Technical Director for the Commercial Auto line of business, the successful candidate will be a positive influence and leader/mentor for aligned risk control consultants while completing complex and high premium auto line of business surveys. The Commercial Auto Technical Director will closely partner with the assigned underwriting team to provide consultative service while supporting project completion. AI utilization, familiarity with industry advancements in vehicle technology applications, and knowledge of Autonomous Vehicles and mobility devices are critical skills.

The role is responsible for training/mentoring less experienced consultants to improve their commercial auto expertise. The Commercial Auto Technical Director will develop (in conjunction with others) the strategy to identify, address, and improve the discipline’s commercial auto skills. The successful candidate will understand the role of emotional intelligence in the coaching process and take ownership of aligned learners’ development.

Self-performed work will include prospective, new business, renewal, and service type visits. The surveys will consist of preparation, account contact, hazard and control evaluation that could include all lines of business, with commercial auto exposure being the leading evaluation. It is preferable but not required that the candidate understands other lines of business such as; liability, property, and workers’ compensation. The self-performed work will support Liberty Mutual Risk Control initiatives and demonstrate the value of doing business with Liberty Mutual. The successful candidate will also take a lead role in delivering and instructing Liberty Mutual driver coaching and fleet management resources, which includes coaching less experienced consultants on the materials and presentation skills.

A key component of the role will be the close collaboration with the Commercial Auto Product and Technical Director. Project work will include development of training curriculum, resources, partnering with internal and external business partners.

What You'll Do in the Commercial Auto Technical Director Role:

  • Strengthen Our Market Leadership: Enhance Liberty Mutual's leadership position in the risk control space by developing key relationships with large-premium, complex clients.
  • Educate and Empower: Provide coaching, training, and resources to risk control consultants and clients to promote best practices in safety and risk management.
  • Collaborate: Work closely with cross-functional teams across Risk Control, Underwriting, and Claims—including direct customer service—to ensure comprehensive risk assessment and management strategies.
  • Survey and Service High Premium and Complex Accounts:Complete prospective and new business surveys and provide targeted service to our largest and most sophisticated clients using our commercial auto specific tools to improve performance and guide underwriting to profitable business.
  • Analyze and Optimize: Use data analytics and industry insights to identify trends, develop actionable strategies, and drive continuous improvement in risk control practices, including applying AI to generate insights and results.
  • Influence the Future: Monitor trends in commercial auto and mobility to shape the direction of our risk control initiatives, influencing policy and procedural changes that enhance our market position.

  • Proven experience in risk control within the commercial auto insurance industry.

  • The ability to monitor and evaluate the technical quality of loss prevention services delivered by less experienced consultants.
  • Strong technical commercial auto knowledge and analytical skills to interpret data and inform decision-making.

  • A commitment to actively acquiring and retaining profitable business.
  • The ability to lead and collaborate on projects.

Description

Lead With Expertise. Deliver Impact That Matters. Grow With a Company That Invests in You.

At Liberty Mutual, we show up for people in their toughest moments, and we show up for our employees with the same commitment. Our Complex Casualty Claims Team is expanding, and we’re seeking a Senior Claims Resolution Specialist who brings deep technical expertise, sharp critical thinking, and a passion for doing what’s right. We are currently hiring for the Central and Southwest Regionsdue to this growth.

If you’re energized by the challenge of managing high‑exposure, complex, and catastrophic injury claims, and you want to work in an environment where professionalism, integrity, and empathy guide everything we do, this is the role for you.

🌟 What Makes This Role Special

You Own the Complex Work

You’ll be the point person on severe and catastrophic auto and homeowner’s casualty claims, navigating litigation, partnering with counsel, and driving strategy.

Your Expertise Is Valued

Your judgment plays a key role in shaping outcomes. You’ll influence decisions on some of our most significant claims, backed by leaders who respect your experience.

Flexibility Meets Purpose

This role is remote or hybrid depending on location, with only a modest two days a month expectationif you live near a hub.

You’ll Keep Growing

From advanced technical training to mentorship opportunities, we’re dedicated to helping you expand your impact.

Competitive Bonus Opportunity

External candidates with an active FL or TX All‑Lines Adjuster License (CEs current) may qualify for a $2,500 sign‑on bonus.

  • Manage the investigation, evaluation, and resolution of complex auto and homeowner’s casualty claims.
  • Assess coverage, liability, and damages; recommend settlement strategies and escalate appropriately for authority review.
  • Identifies potential suspicious claims and refers to SIU and identifies opportunities for third party subrogation.
  • Collaborate closely with trial counsel; attend mediations, arbitrations, trials, hearings, and conferences.
  • Prepare detailed litigation and trial reports for local management and Home Office.
  • Communicate effectively with policyholders, witnesses, attorneys, and claimants to gather information and provide guidance.
  • Responds to various written and telephone inquiries including status reports.
  • Maintain accurate reserves, recommending increases on cases in excess of authority.
  • Safeguard financial and confidential information across all claim files.
  • Oversee billing practices of outside and in‑house counsel to ensure compliance and cost efficiency.
  • May assist as a resource to the team, stepping in for the Claims Team Manager when needed or mentoring colleagues; or representing the company on matters involving state or federal regulatory agencies.
  • Participate in special projects at the direction of leadership.

What You Bring

Ideal Experience Includes:

  • 5+ years managing complex and litigated casualty claims
  • Deep expertise handling severe to catastrophic injuries and fatalities
  • Strong analytical thinking, negotiation skills, and sound judgment
  • Ability to thrive in a fast‑paced, high‑stakes environment

If you live within 50 miles of one of our hub locations, the role is hybrid (2 days in office). Otherwise, it may be fully remote.Candidates located in theCentral, Mountain, or Pacifictime zones would be most ideal as this position supports claims located in the Central and Southwestregions.

Liberty Lake, WA
Marlton, NJ

Training That Sets You Up for Success

Your growth begins on day one. Active engagement and reliable attendance during training are mandatory and crucial to your success in this high‑impact role.

You will work in a team of claims professionals who may work in office or remote depending on their location. You will partner with a strong leadership team that values accountability, collaboration, and growth. If you enjoy working along top talent, making tough decisions, and being part of a team that takes pride in doing the right thing at the right time, this is a place where you can build something bigger than just your next role.

This includes making decisions about liability/compensability, evaluating losses, negotiating settlements and managing an inventory of commercial property/casualty claims involving bodily injury or property loss. The Senior Claims Specialist may also assist the Claims Team Manager with assigning new claims to team members, providing technical direction, and monitoring caseloads.

This is a remote position. You will be required to go into the office twice a month if you reside within 50 miles of one of the following offices: Boston, MA; Suwanee, GA; Plano, TX or Hoffman Estates, IL. Please note this policy is subject to change.

  • Drive proactive claim outcomes through early investigations and strategic decision making. Own the full claim lifecycle from coverage analysis and reserving to negotiation and resolution – by making timely, well-supported decisions. Actively manage litigation, set clear expectations with clients and counsel, and pursue early resolution strategies to reduce cycle time, legal spend, and overall claim severity.
  • Acts as senior technical professional on team, mentor and elevate team performance through coaching. Serve as a resource for less experienced adjusters by providing real-time guidance on coverage, liability, and investigation strategy. Reinforce best practices in documentation, reserving and communication, contributing to improved QA outcomes and consistent execution across the team.
  • Participates in conducting Suit Committees, Roundtables, Arbitrations, Mediations, field investigations and may assist in conducting closed file reviews.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Demonstrated ability to handle multi-part litigation, contract interpretation, and risk transfer (additional insured and indemnity) preferred. interpersonal skills to communicate and negotiate with customers and conduct investigations required.

This role is designed as an early-career development opportunity with structured support and training from the Platform Experience Leader. The Associate Experience Manager will build experience in digital enablement, content experience, platform operations, stakeholder engagement, and change management while helping the team scale execution capacity during a period of significant transformation.

Responsibilities

  • Support platform experience activities that make it easier for sellers, partners, and stakeholders to find the right resources, understand what to do next, and engage with enablement platforms confidently.
  • Assist with page readiness, page review, navigation updates, content placement, and experience quality checks across The Sales Hub and related platform experiences.
  • Partner with the Platform Experience Leader to support content organization, taxonomy alignment, journey design, and usability improvements.
  • Help coordinate stakeholder inputs, feedback, and follow-ups to keep platform experience work moving across multiple teams and workstreams.
  • Support adoption and activation activities by helping prepare guidance, communications, enablement materials, and stakeholder resources.
  • Track open experience issues, risks, decisions, and action items to ensure follow-through and visibility for program leadership.
  • Assist with reviewing feedback from sellers, partners, content stakeholders, and support channels to identify common pain points and improvement opportunities.
  • Document repeatable processes, operating guidance, and lessons learned to help scale the platform experience operating model over time.
  • Collaborate with content experience administrators, system administrators, support services, reporting resources, and program leadership to help maintain a connected and consistent experience.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement efforts by bringing forward observations, recommended fixes, and practical ideas that improve usability, clarity, and adoption.

Required Skills and Competencies

  • Strong curiosity and willingness to learn new platforms, processes, and ways of working.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to review pages, content placement, and user experience elements for clarity and consistency.
  • Strong organizational skills, including the ability to track multiple tasks, follow up on open items, and keep work moving across stakeholders.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to summarize issues, document processes, and provide practical updates.
  • Comfort working in a fast-moving, evolving environment where priorities may shift and processes may still be forming.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams while also taking ownership of assigned tasks.
  • Problem-solving mindset with the ability to identify gaps, raise issues early, and recommend simple, practical solutions.
  • Interest in digital enablement, sales enablement, content experience, platform operations, user experience, communications, or change management.
  • Basic experience with Microsoft Office, collaboration tools, content platforms, learning platforms, or digital workplace tools preferred.

The salary offered will be determined by the candidate's location, qualifications, experience, and education and may be outside of this range. The range is based on 'On Target Earnings’ (OTE) representing the total potential earnings, which is the sum of the base salary and potential commission earned when performance targets are achieved. Final compensation packages are competitive and in line with industry standards, reflecting a variety of factors, and include a comprehensive benefits package. This may cover Health Insurance, Life Insurance, Retirement or Pension Plans, Paid Time Off (PTO), various Leave options, employee stock purchase plan, and/or restricted stocks (RSU’s).
